text.en:
Your day, read back by your companion: hold your companion and tap Your day, or open My day. Meals with their likely blood sugar spike, your longest gap, Move, water, care sent and points, one honest takeaway, one tip for tomorrow and one line for your journal. It also shows after you save Catch up on today.

Only get to your phone at night? Catch up on today: one big bubble at a time for Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks, Water and Movement. Tap what you had, then one Save. It's the first row in Settings, and in the evening your companion offers it.

Finish any Move session, Mirror mode and Deadlift too, and you get the biggest reward in the app, plus a big celebration. Every finished session now shows in This week and History.

In your Cart, tap Someone else pays: the whole cart becomes a Give a hand basket. Add a rough total and your pay link, then share.

In Supermarket, tap + on any product to put it in your Cart without opening it. The house puts it straight into your Kitchen.

Speak instead of typing: food names, searches, Kitchen, shopping list, snacks, captions and chat have a small mic inside the text field. Tap it and say it, tap again to stop. It uses your phone's own free speech recognition. In the Home Screen app on iPhone, the mic opens the keyboard: tap the keyboard's own mic there.

Cook now opens on Kitchen. Want another game first? Hold its tab until it wiggles, then slide it to the front.

The scanner card got clearer: a small curve shows the estimated blood sugar rise, How often says how many times a week it fits, and Why? explains the verdict in plain words. Plain nuts and cheese are now rated for their usual small portion.

Shop finds is simpler: scan food while you shop to earn XP for your companion, with Power combos right at the top.

Every scan now shows the same short card: one verdict, a better pick when it helps, and the rest under Details.

Supermarket has Shop from home now. Say how many people you shop for, your budget and how many dinners, and you get a week of low-spike dinners with an estimated total for each store. Swap any dinner, tick what you already have at home, then put the rest in your Cart in one tap.

Supermarket in Shop has a Cart now, with amounts you can change and an estimated total. The total only uses prices people reported in the shop. Seller Zone keeps its own tab.

Give a hand is a swipe deck: swipe a grocery basket right to pay for it with that person's own payment link, left to skip. Undo brings it back.

Your kitchen is a game now: open Cook and tap Kitchen, right next to Shuffle and Swipe. A fridge and a cabinet hold what you have at home, each door opens its shelf, and a bar shows how healthy your kitchen is. Ran out of something? Bin it and it lands on your shopping list; tap Bought and it is back on its shelf.

Give a hand now has its own tab in Shop, right next to Kitchen.

Under About you you can now pick Woman, Man, Non-binary or Prefer not to say. And you can type in a condition that isn't on the list, like sickle cell disease. That note stays on your phone.

After your meal in Gap can now be read to you: tap the speaker on a phase card and the tutorial voice reads it, at 1×, 1.5× or 2×. Tap again to stop. Gap now also opens on the phase you are in right now.

After your meal in Gap: what your blood sugar typically does, phase by phase, and one easy way to lower the spike in each.

Fixing a food photo: as you type, your Kitchen and your scans come up first, and Add food adds what it missed.

My cycle, if you track it: a gentle How are you today?, plus a gentle day and a calm world you switch on yourself. Your cycle settings are back too. Only you see it.

Kitchen in Shop: keep track of what you have at home, and a shopping cart for later. Tap Bought and it moves into your kitchen. Only you see it.

Tutorial voice speed: like a voice note, tap 1× next to Pause for 1.5× or 2×. The voice speeds up right away, sounds natural, and your speed is remembered.

Everyone in LOWiSPIKE, in one list. Open the Community menu and tap People: you see everyone in the app with name and photo, offline people too, and you can search by name. Tap someone to open their profile, close it to get back to the list.

Hold Scan to open every bubble. On Home, hold the Scan button for a moment and every bubble opens at once in one circle round Misty. A quick tap still opens Scan. Tap the empty space to close them.

Community cards now show birthdays with a countdown, star signs and personality types. Before, every card said Not shared. Every card shows your birthday as day and month with a countdown, never the year or your age, plus your star sign. Your personality type shows too if you have one. No type yet? Your own card links the free personality test in your language and lets you save the result with I know my type.

The chat and the ranking now show only real people. The test accounts and simulated members are gone.

In day mode you can now see what you type in the chat. Before, the letters were white on the light message field.

Typing "muesli with milk" into Log a meal is now logged as muesli and milk. Before, it was read as a glass of milk alone. Bircher muesli works too, and a muesli bar stays a bar.

A meal typed in Spanish into Log a meal is now rated the same as in English or German. Before, "Avena con leche" was read as milk alone and earned +15 XP, while "Oats with milk" earned none. Now avena, arroz, pan, pollo and other everyday Spanish food words are understood, and "sin" leaves a food out, like "without".

Cycle tracking for women, only if you want it. Setup asks, and My cycle in your profile shows your phase as a little cell world. Log the first day of your period in one tap.

Typing "Oats with milk" into Log a meal was understood as oat milk, a 110 kcal drink. Oats, overnight oats and rolled oats now count as oatmeal, and oat milk is still oat milk. The ingredients no longer list things like "vitamin d as ingredient". And on a meal photo in German or Spanish, the LOWiSPIKE line now explains its verdict in your language.

Only real people on the Ranking and in Add a friend. Bots and test accounts are gone from both, and each name shows up once. The bots stay in the chat with their daily photos.

When you type a food in Scan, the Best swap line now shows in German and Spanish too. Before, foods like apple, milk or oats showed it in English, for example "A small handful of berries & a palm of protein".

Bubble words stay whole. The small bubbles round Misty no longer split a word in the middle, like "Flasch" on one line and "e" on the next. A label now wraps only between words, and a word that is too long for its bubble gets a little smaller instead. Thanks, Lisa, for spotting it.

New companions now mix your birthday with something only your account has, so two people born on the same day get different companions. Yours stays exactly as it is.

Swiping back on Shop it now closes Shop it, and you stay on Cook. Before, Shop it stayed open, Cook closed behind it, and the next swipe left the app. In the shop list, back closes the list first, then Shop it.

What's New is now a short tour in the tutorial's style. It takes you to each new thing in the app and shows it to you, and you can skip it anytime. It shows once per update. This time: Rooms, Deadlift in Mirror mode, the Seller Zone, Sleep in your bubble ring, and iPhone and iPad in sync.

Adding LOWiSPIKE to your Home Screen is now a small animated walkthrough instead of a wall of text. Pick iPhone or Android (we preselect yours) and watch the exact taps loop: on iPhone •••, Share, View More, Add to Home Screen, Open as Web App on, Add. Coming from Instagram, TikTok or WhatsApp, it shows how to get into Safari or Chrome first. On Android phones that allow it, one tap on Install app opens the system dialog. In Safari a glowing arrow points at the real ••• button, and the first time you open the app from your Home Screen, Misty celebrates with you.

Fixed: "New in this update" no longer keeps coming back. Each update is announced once, in one card. Got it or Show me closes it for good, also after a reload and on your other device. Later keeps update notices quiet for 3 hours.

A clearer setup. The step about you is now called About you and says why we ask: so your tips fit you. The shopping step says in one line what it is for, without things you haven't seen yet. And when your companion is born it gets a friendly name: tap New name for another one, or Type my own and give it any name you like.

Deadlift in Mirror mode. Open Move and tap Deadlift. Stand the phone at knee to hip height, step back about 2.5 m and stand side-on. A glowing outline shows you the hinge with a flat back and hips back, stays at most one rep ahead and waits for you at the top. Reps count from your own hip hinge, not the clock, and half reps don't count. Form tips pop up in bubbles, every rep bubble glows teal when it was clean, and Misty cheers after each set. 3 sets of 8 with a short rest you can skip.

Update notes are right again. After several of today's updates, the note offered the tour of an older change, like "Bubbles open in one round circle" or the Seller Zone photos, and the update's own news never showed. What you missed is right below, newest first: rooms you can start yourself, and one Misty on your iPhone and iPad.

Same Misty on every device. Your iPhone and iPad now share one state: water, fasting and the Gap, meals, Move, sleep, XP, level and Misty's care. When you open the app or come back to it, it catches up with your other device and says so with a short note. If both devices logged something, both entries stay, nothing counts twice. Your language stays per device, and health data still never leaves your phone.

The Seller Zone now shows real product photos. Every snack has its photo from its own shop, so you see what you buy at a glance. The cards are now a shelf: the photo first, with the verdict and the price on it, then the name, the portion and where it ships. Two across on iPhone, three on iPad. Why it passes and the ingredients open with one tap. Tap the photo to open the shop. The shelf in Shop and the swaps under a scan show the photos too.

In German, the sign reveal in setup said things like "Geboren aus die zwei Fische". It now reads "Geboren aus den zwei Fischen" for every sign. Also, choosing A woman, A man or Prefer not to say in setup no longer makes the whole screen blink.

The Seller Zone now lives right in Shop. Open Fuel, then Shop: on top you now see two tabs, Supermarket and Seller Zone. The Seller Zone tab shows the whole zone, with the same cards, shelves and regions, and you scroll through all the snacks right there. On the Supermarket tab, a shelf of the zone's snacks now sits at the top, and you swipe through it sideways. Tap a snack and the zone opens right on its card. Shop remembers the tab you left it on.

The Seller Zone now starts with shops that deliver where you are, even if your phone is set to another language. In Germany you see Germany and EU first. You can still switch to UK or USA.

Every bubble now looks like a real bubble. Log meal, Cook, Shop, Sips, Cup, Bottle, Casual, Steady and Epic wear the same light, living membrane as Misty and the bubbles around her. Sleep now opens like the others: tap it and 7 h+, 6–7 h and <6 h bloom on the same circle, with last night's answer marked. Hold Scan to open all twelve on one full, even circle.

New: the Seller Zone, snacks you can order. Craving chips, chocolate, gummies or biscuits? Scan them, and under the verdict you now see real snacks you can buy instead, like cheese crisps, seaweed snacks, 100% cacao, biltong or salted nuts. Each one was checked against our strict scanner rules, and each link opens the shop's own product page. Open the whole zone from Fuel, then Shop, or from See all on the scan card. Pick your region, Germany and EU, UK or USA. Gummies and sweet biscuits did not pass anywhere, so the zone says that honestly and offers a chewy or crunchy swap.

Community is calmer. The half-hidden chat card that stuck at the top of the screen is gone for good, and the Community menu no longer has the Replies & mentions entry. Rooms & people, Find, your profile, Invite and Settings are where they were.

Your universe is full again. An earlier cleanup had removed the living bloodstream along with the old Home, so the world around Misty was empty. Now red cells, white cells and platelets drift past again, with light shafts and the glowing body places out in the fog.

Affiliates: the earnings page now explains the recruit bonus properly. Every active recruit counts like 5 sales, and every 3 active recruits lift you one more level. That's why 3 recruits put you on level 3, even though 15 sales alone would be level 2.

The Ranking is quicker to read. Fewer words, more symbols: sunbeams, XP, medals and arrows for places won or lost. The podium rises, the places slide into line when you switch Week, Month and All time, and your own place glows. The rules are behind the small i. Tap a companion to go head to head: one bar, one line for what it takes, and your numbers side by side.

Your universe stays whole when the bubbles open. Before, tapping Fuel, Water or Move, or opening them all, shrank the world into a flat box. Now the camera simply pulls back, and the whole living world stays around you, edge to edge.

On the Ranking, Your place showed an old name for your companion, like "Sunny Leaf", and that's also the name other people saw. Now it shows the same name as Misty's card.

Zooming in on Home no longer brings back the old Home. When you pulled the camera close, Misty grew so big that the bubble ring gave up, and the old layout appeared: the Daily Quest box at the top, the Today pill at the bottom, Fast and Water round a giant Misty. Now the ring stays put while you zoom in, on iPhone and iPad.

Bubbles open in one round circle. Tap Fuel, Water or Move: the small bubbles now sit evenly on one circle round Misty, and the view zooms out to make room. Mirror left the Move bubbles: hold Move, it is the first card on the Move page. Hold Scan to open every bubble together. Tap the empty space to close them.

Every meal you log now restarts the Gap from the time you ate, whether it comes from Log meal, the scanner, a recipe, cooked groceries or your other device. A breakfast after 11 AM counts too. Removed a meal or moved its time? The Gap moves back with it, and fasting XP is never paid twice.

The Gap bubble on Home is quieter: just the time since your last meal, like 3:09, without the extra line.

Entering a cell world now tells you where you are, like Liver / Liver lobule or Small intestine / Villi.

The guide you meet in each world is named after the real cell it stands for: Neuron, Alveolar cell, Cardiomyocyte, Hepatocyte, Beta cell, Enterocyte and Muscle fibre.

Fly close to things and a small label names them: glycogen, the central vein, insulin, mitochondria and more. Tap a label for one short sentence on what is happening there. Every term was checked against anatomy and physiology sources.

The Ranking now says why. A line under Week, Month and All time explains what each board counts and when it starts again.

Tap any companion for You vs them: both of you on every board, sunbeams per day, full-sun days, level, where the sunbeams came from, and what it takes to pass them, even what would do it today. Compare the top 3 puts the podium side by side. A tie now says who wins the tie-break and why.

The Ranking also sits in the same rounded panel as Room, Chat, Creation and Affiliates, with no dark bar behind the tabs. The list scrolls inside the panel, so nothing slides over the tabs.

Going back from Community to Home froze the app. After the Ranking, Creation or Affiliates tab, Home stayed stuck on a zoomed-out picture with Misty and the ring of bubbles, nothing moved and nothing could be tapped until you closed the app. Now back, by the button or a swipe, always lands on a working Home.

Log what you cooked. The Today's groceries sheet now has a What you cooked part: type the meal and tap Log it, or Snap a photo, and tap the chips for the groceries that went in. Cooked this on a recipe fills it in for you. It goes into your normal meal journal with the same rules, and your groceries link to it.

The "Not in any database yet" sheet now fits on one screen, no scrolling. Name and Analyze sit in one row, Deep analyze and Label photos are two tiles side by side, and Don't save and the catch button stay above the keyboard.

No more catch ball. An insulin-friendly food is caught in a metabolic bubble: it rises out of the button, the product drops inside, the bubble seals with a wobble and floats up into your Bubble Dex.

Only insulin-friendly foods can be caught and join the shared database. A yellow or spike food shows why, a Skip button and the best swap, and nothing is saved.

Your companion's card now shows a tiny peek at the Ranking, right under its level: its place worldwide, with the companion just above and just below next to it.

It shows the board where your place is best (Week, Month or All time) and says which one. It counts the same way as the Ranking: real players only, and you count once.

Tap it to open the Ranking on that board, at Your place.

No more counting cups. Just estimate what you drank: a few sips are about 60 ml, a cup about 250 ml and a whole bottle about 750 ml. Each tap fills Water by that much, and Misty drinks with you.

Your goal stays 6 cups, about 1.5 litres. Water still earns 2 XP for every full cup, up to 6 cups a day, so at most 12 XP. Four sips earn the same as one cup.

The old Home is gone for good. Leftover layers from the earlier Home still drew over and behind your living bubbles: the silvery discs, the white cells and light shafts, the glowing orbs with rings, the faded "Back in the bloodstream" banner under the Daily Quest and the "New in" countdown. That code is deleted, so Home only shows Misty and your bubbles, on iPhone and iPad, inside worlds too.

No more pale disc on the bubbles. The flat white oval that floated next to Misty when she flew out, and sat on every bubble, is gone. The bubbles keep their glass shine.

In setup, if the app reloaded while your sign was being revealed, your birthday came back but the birth time you typed was gone. Now both come back.

Zooming out no longer drops you into Community. Before, if you pinched out far enough on Home to see the universe, the app suddenly jumped into Community. That shortcut is gone: pinch out as far as you like and you stay in the universe. To open Community, tap its bubble, use the tabs or swipe sideways.

In German and Spanish, the food you shuffled in Cook showed its kind and time in English, like "Sweet · 5 min + chill". Now it shows them in your language.

Scan by name. In the camera, a field next to the barcode lets you type a food or product name. You see the verdict while you type, and Go shows the full result like a scan: Misty's spike animation, the verdict, the best swap (often a Recipe Book recipe) and the scan's own data when there is any. A product the database doesn't know yet now has an Analyze button right next to its name. Plantain chips, Maduritos, Chifles and Tostones now count as Spike, and ticking None of these can't turn them green any more. A name check is always an estimate: add label photos to make it exact.

In setup, "Check your birthday" stayed on screen after you had already fixed the date. Now the message goes away as soon as you change your birthday or name.

On Move, swiping back with Milestones open closed the sheet and also jumped you to Home. Now back just closes Milestones and you stay on Move.

New: the level ladder. On the Ranking, tap Your place. You see your companion's level, how much XP is left to the next one, and all 25 levels with how many players have reached each. Levels you've reached glow, the rest are locked. Only real accounts count, and each person counts once.

The Ranking now shows the names people gave their companions, with the evolution form and level underneath and the owner's name in small. A companion whose owner hasn't opened the new version yet keeps showing its form until they do.

The food scanner follows the new LOWiSPIKE Master Knowledge. When a scan or a logged meal is a craving like döner, bolognese, fried rice, ramen, tacos, crisps, cheesecake, a bagel with salmon, tiramisu, an ice lolly, lemonade or a chai latte, the swap card opens the matching recipe from the Recipe Book, now 38 recipes, and can add its ingredients to your shopping list.

Milk now depends on the amount, everywhere: a splash in coffee or tea is green, a glass of milk is yellow.

New here? The last setup screen now speaks your language: in German and Spanish, "You're all set" and your sign show up translated. And the little "drag here to fly" tip now waits until Home is clear, so you actually see it instead of it popping up hidden behind setup.

The Ranking is cleaner. When you scroll, the Community bar with its tabs stays on top as one solid glass bar, so nothing shows through it anymore. Week, Month and All time now show the top 10 only, and Your place still shows your real place even below 10. The demo companions are gone: only real people with their real stats are on the board.

New: the Ranking. Community has a fifth tab, Ranking, next to Room, Chat, Creation and Affiliates. Switch between Week, Month and All time, see your place, a podium for the top three and the full list. Every spot shows that person's companion, not a photo, and a tap opens their card. Week and Month count care points, All time counts companion XP. The Care board card and the Milestones row are gone from Move, and every old board link now opens the Ranking.

Move now works like Sleep. At the end of the day, check the step counter on your phone, tap Move and pick Casual (under 5k), Steady (5k to 10k) or Epic (10k or more). One range a day: another pick replaces it, and tapping the same one again adds nothing. The app doesn't count your steps, it takes your word.

Sleep is simpler: the separate Clear bubble is gone. You always see the three choices, and tapping another one replaces today's.

Swiping back with the meal-gap view open on Home closed LOWiSPIKE. Now it just closes the view and you stay on Home. And on Move, back from the Care board takes you back to Move, like its own back button, instead of jumping to Home and leaving the board open.

New: Today's groceries. Open Today's bucket on a product card and tap Today's groceries + what to cook. You see everything you bought today with the total price and spike points, and up to three recipes from Cook that use those groceries. Each one shows what it uses and what you'd still need, and one tap opens the recipe.

Mirror mode is up front now: tap Move on Home and Mirror is the first, glowing bubble, so the camera workout is two taps away. On the Move page it's the big first card at the top, with Start right there.

Your grocery bucket now shows prices and points. Open Today's bucket on a product card and pick the shop you're in: when someone has reported a price for an item at that shop, you see it, and when no price is known you can type the one on the shelf. Each item shows its spike points from the card's blood sugar meter, and the bucket adds up the total price for your shop and the total spike points. Prices are never made up, and your shop and typed prices are saved per day on your phone.

If the app updated while it was closed, Misty now tells you what's new the next time you open it on Home. Before, that note only showed when you tapped the update banner, so after a normal reopen you never saw it. It shows once per update, and Got it closes it.

Scanned products have a place to go now. After you check a product with Scan, tap Add to bucket to keep it in today's grocery bucket, or Skip to close the card and scan the next one. The card shows how many items are in today's bucket, Undo takes it back out, and Today's bucket lists everything you added so you can remove items. The bucket is saved per day on your phone. Prices and points come next.

Photo meals now keep their photo and Misty's estimate. Long-press Fuel to see today's meals with a small picture each, and tap one to see the photo, the saved estimate, Share or Delete. Right after Log as meal you can tap Share to Community: only the photo, the dish name and the spike rating go to the room, never your weight or other health data. Your meal photos stay on your phone unless you share one.

Leaving a world looks clean now: Misty's sparkle trail is soft round glowing dots instead of the white boxes that used to stack up on the way out. Sparkles that drift right up to the camera simply fade away, and on a light sky they keep their colour instead of burning white.

The old World map button is gone. It was from before the cell worlds. Inside a world, the round X at the bottom takes you straight back to Misty, and a guide's speech bubble never covers it. The map is out of the Community hub and the tutorial too.

Snapping your plate in Log a meal no longer gives up too early. Misty now waits properly for the photo check, shows "Misty is looking…" while she reads it and takes a second look on her own if the first try is slow. If it still misses, tap Try again and she re-reads the same photo, no new picture needed. Log as meal is in the brand blue now.

Fixed in Affiliates: if a code didn't work on one script, "That code doesn't work" also showed up under the other scripts, where you hadn't typed anything. The message now stays with the script you typed the code on and goes away when you switch.

Products you caught before the Food check existed now follow it too. Your Dex and your catches re-check them when the app opens, so cooked ham caught last week is marked as a NO in your Dex instead of an old OK. It only ever gets stricter, and products you entered yourself keep your own rating.

Tap Misty and her card now opens with World glow: one bar to her true peak, Supernova, and a short list of what's still missing, like a sugar rush that is still clearing, a stormy world, water, a Move or a low-spike meal. Tap a missing line to go straight where you fix it. It never says 100% while anything holds her back, and at Supernova she smiles, glows and the world is at its brightest.

Misty now reacts to a scan with the same Food check as the scanner card, so she no longer cheers for a product the card says NO to. And Italian salame now counts as pork like salami, so it is left out of Store picks; poultry or beef salame stays an occasional processed meat.

Misty's speech bubbles are small now: a compact glass card in LOWiSPIKE blue, at most two short lines, never wider than about two thirds of the screen. Tap a longer line to read it in full, tap again to close. She says one thing at a time, so bubbles no longer stack, and they keep clear of the Home bubbles and the joystick. The guides in the worlds talk the same way.

Store picks now use the same Food check as the scanner card. No more guessed glycemic index: each product shows a Lower, Moderate or Higher blood sugar impact for a normal portion, and anything the card says NO to is left out instead of showing up as Good or Best.

Misty's card is tidier: the Food journal door, the Tell Misty how you feel check-in and the Hunt power row are gone. Forms and Glow sit right under her name, then her energy, level and adventures. Hunt power-ups still give her energy, you just don't see a separate row for them anymore.

Your spike lists now follow the Food check card too, so a product the card says NO to can't sit under "Likely won't spike" anymore. And turkey or chicken speck (Putenspeck) is rated as processed meat, so now and then, not as a plain poultry YES.

One sheet at a time: when something opens from a sheet, it takes that sheet's place, so nothing shows through behind it. Close it any way you like and you land straight back on the page, with nothing left hiding underneath. A small back arrow at the top left brings the sheet before it back.

Fixed: in the Community chat the keyboard closed every time you tapped Send, so you had to tap the message field again before you could write the next message. The keyboard now stays up after you send, like in any messenger.

The shopping scan now shows the same verdict as the Food check card, worked out fresh every time, so an old rating can't make a NO product look fine. And poultry or beef salami no longer counts as pork: it's rated as processed meat, so now and then.

Shuffle, Throw out, Buy picks and your shopping matches now follow the Food check on the scan card. A product the card says NO to goes to Throw out instead of your meals, and a RARELY product only counts as now and then.

You can now pick your serving on a scanned product. It starts at the maker's serving when the pack has one, and you can tap the usual portion, the whole pack or 100 g, or type your own grams (ml for drinks). The blood sugar estimate, the Food check verdict and the nutrition update right away for the amount you chose.

Pinned messages in the chat room are real now: only the app admin can pin one. It shows as a slim bar at the top of the room, and one tap on it jumps straight to that message. Nothing pinned, no bar.

Fixed: the Forms page in Misty's card showed an old, made-up name at the top (like "Sunny Leaf") instead of your companion's name. It now shows the same name as the rest of the app, including one you picked yourself.

Scanned products now get a Food check card right under the blood sugar estimate. A traffic light says YES, RARELY or NO, with two or three short reasons why, the nutrition for one serving, the food quality and, for anything marked RARELY or NO, a better choice. Details shows how the estimate was worked out, craving risk and fullness, and how complete the product data is.

Fixed: in the Community chat the message bar now sits above Safari's toolbar and the home indicator, and right on top of the keyboard while you type. The page no longer slides away when you tap the field, and the newest message stays in view.

When a scanned product is missing its nutrition label or ingredient list, the card now offers Add label photos. Take one photo of the nutrition table and one of the ingredients. Where your phone can read text from photos, the form fills itself in. You check every value against the pack before it counts, anything you leave blank stays unknown, and the photos stay on your phone.

Community and the chat are lighter on your phone: screens you can't see no longer keep their glass blur running in the background. About 20 hidden blur layers used to sit under Community and the chat room.

The scanner now also checks how solid its information about a product is: High when the exact product, its full ingredient list and a complete label are known, Medium when some details are missing, and Low when the product is unclear or the label numbers don't add up. It's about the data only, never about your body. You will see it on the new scanner result card soon.

Leaving the chat is clean now: tap back and you glide straight home to Misty. The chat background no longer stays stuck over Home.

Fixed: tapping Finds while you scan in the shop did nothing you could see. Shop finds opened hidden behind the camera. Now the camera closes and Shop finds opens right away.

Behind the scenes the scanner now also judges food quality on its own, notices snacks that make it easy to keep eating, sums up the two or three main reasons for its rating, and picks a better choice, like 25 to 30 g of plain roasted almonds instead of a sweet nut mix. You will see all of this on the new scanner result card soon.

The scanner now reads the whole ingredient list, brackets included: added sugar, syrups, honey, fast starch and sweeteners are found even when they hide inside another ingredient, and the 14 main allergens are picked out. Claims like High Protein, Low Carb, Keto or Zero never make a product look better. Behind the scenes every product also gets checked against the LOWiSPIKE food rules (yes, rarely, no), ready for the next scanner update.

New: Misty now has 25 levels instead of 10, with an evolution at levels 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25. From level 7 each level takes a bit longer, and nobody drops a level: if the new curve would put you lower, you keep your level until you pass it.

Smarter scanner: every product now gets a Lower, Moderate or Higher estimated blood sugar impact, worked out from the carbs and sugar in a real serving, not per 100 g. Protein, fat and fibre no longer hide the carbs, and when the label lacks the numbers you'll see Not enough data to estimate instead of a guess. It's always an estimate, never a promise of no spike.

Chat in LOWiSPIKE colours: no more green or violet. Your messages and the send button are brand blue, the room is calm charcoal by Night and soft cream by Day, and it follows your Day/Night setting.

Fixed: going back while a scanned product or another sheet was open on Home could close LOWiSPIKE instead of the sheet. Now back just closes the sheet.

Calmer Community: the top bar with Room, Chat, Creation and Affiliates now stays in exactly the same place on every tab, Chat included. The extra room bar, pinned banner and members button are gone, the back button sits where it always does, and the message box stays visible while you type.

New: six animated auras for Misty. Open her card, tap Aura, preview one and unlock it with sparks. Every XP you earn adds one spark, and spending never lowers your XP or level.

Your presence now lives in your profile: tap your picture in Community and you find it right next to Profile, with how others see your companion, sharing, quiet hours and blocked people. The extra shield badge next to the Community name is gone.

Fixed: coming back to Home from Community or another section could sometimes throw you out of LOWiSPIKE or reload it. You now stay in the app.

Weight journey now lives inside Weight & BMI: one sheet, one weigh-in, your progress and chart together.

Fixed: after "I just ate this", the meal's name now shows in your language.

Fixed: the "Misty grew!" celebration no longer pops up again every time you reopen or update the app. Each new form still gets its party, once.

New in Cook: tap I just ate this on your Shuffle pick, after a right swipe or at the end of a cook-along and the meal is logged right away. I'll eat this puts it on today's plan. Undo is right there.

Tidier: the menu you get by holding Community no longer has a More places section. For You is in Cook, the Care board in Move.

Community is tidier: privacy is a small icon, the friends tree has a label, Milestones are in Move.

Shuffle in Cook, Products now always has something for you: it picks from low-spike products in your supermarket's range, plus the ones you and the community scanned. No more empty "Your pick" window.

Left the tutorial to try something? A small Continue tutorial button now stays on screen until you finish the tour or tap Skip all, and one tap takes you to the next card. It finds a free spot on every screen: it never covers Send, the photo button or the room tabs in a chat room, or Back and the level card on your profile, and it shows on sheets too. It moves out of the way right away when a screen slides in, you scroll, or a sheet opens.

Your hub now looks like every other sheet: the same dark glass, the handle on top and the round X at the bottom. Profile, Weight & BMI and Weight journey are one-tap tiles, the settings are short rows, and Delete account sits small at the bottom. The dark band behind the handle is gone, and the X no longer covers anything in a sheet.

Once you turn sound on, it stays on until you turn it off yourself. That goes for World sound, the tutorial voice and the app sounds. Switching apps, locking your phone, closing the app or reloading no longer turns it off. When you come back, the sound comes back too. If your phone needs a tap first, the switch still shows on and your first tap anywhere brings the sound back. A script that was being read aloud goes on from the same line.

The group chat has a fresh, cleaner look in day and night mode. Messages sit in simple bubbles with the time right inside, reactions are small pills, and a button takes you back to the newest message. The top bar floats over the chat, and older messages now slide under one clean edge instead of showing through behind it. The typing bar sits just above the bottom of your screen. In day mode the tabs above the chat are white with dark text, and the tab you're on is marked in teal.

One tap on Account now opens your profile overview, with your picture, level and every tile in one clear place. Tap a tile to open it, and Back always brings you back to the overview. The round arrow no longer covers the Back button.

Hold the Community bubble on Home for a moment and your profile hub opens: your picture, your name and XP, and everything that's yours. Tap your picture or Profile to open your profile. Your settings are right there in the hub too. A normal tap on Community still opens Community.

The tutorial now shows you instead of just telling you. On the first cards a little finger does the gesture right on your companion and the bubbles: tap, hold or drag. On the bubbles card each real bubble lights up in turn. And when a card talks about something that opens, like the water cups or the Fuel menu, a small picture of it plays on the card. More cards follow in the next updates.

Every tutorial card that asks you to do something can now be done. Try the gesture on a small practice pad right on the card, or the card says it's for after the tour and shows the motion. Shoot energy works as it says: keep one finger on the little joystick and tap the world twice with the other.

Shuffle with your products now only uses products that won't spike. In Cook, Shuffle, Products, every pick comes from the scans rated Low-spike or Now and then. Anything rated Skip it stays out of your meals and sits in a new Throw out list underneath, with the line: Will likely spike insulin. Swap them next time you shop, and tap the cross to clear one from the list. If none of your scans fit yet, Shuffle says so and offers to scan more or shuffle the eBook recipes.

New: Your details. Everything about you now has one home, one tap from your profile: Body (weight, height, BMI, Weight journey), About you (photo, name, birthday, personality type, gender), Goals, Health (what we should look out for, blood pressure log, private health details) and Account (email, password). Tap your weight under your name to add today's weight right away, already filled in. About you, Health and Account moved into Your details, nothing was removed.

Your profile hub got simpler. Hold the Community bubble on Home, or tap your picture in Community, and you get you first, then the settings that matter: Day or night, Look & sound, language, the tutorial and your account, with Delete account at the bottom. The Explore list is gone. For You, Care board, World map, Gift of the day and Shopping hunt are folded under More places, and Workouts is still behind the Move bubble.

Misty's levels now have the same names everywhere: your profile, her growth map and Community all show the cell stages, from Spark to Legend and beyond. The growth map now shows your total XP, how much is left to the next level, and whether a glow is already yours. How you earn XP now lists everything that really gives XP.

When your companion levels up, the celebration now always shows your own companion in its current look, before and after, the same one you see on Home. Before, if the level-up was found while the app was still opening, for example after you collected points on another phone, it could show the old flower-pot design. That old design is now gone everywhere.

Shop now shows the supermarkets near you, not one fixed town. Tap Share my location to see your address and the nearest supermarkets, sorted by distance. Tap one to see its products: the chain's own list for REWE, EDEKA, Lidl, Aldi, Kaufland, Netto, Penny and more, or the general list for other shops, because supermarkets mostly carry the same items. Location off? Type a town or postcode, or skip to the general lists. Your location is only used on your phone to look things up on OpenStreetMap. It isn't sent to us or saved.

New: your Weight journey. Set the day your journey or challenge started, your start weight and a goal if you like. Add a weight in two taps, also for days you missed, and edit or delete any entry. Your line shows the week, month, three months, year, everything or Since start, with day 1 and a dashed goal line. The cards show how much you've changed since you started, your weekly and monthly rate, your highest and lowest, and how far it is to your goal. Works in kilos or pounds. Open it from Community, You, Weight journey, or from Weight and BMI. It stays on your phone.

Try it now in the tutorial is a real button now. It gives a little wiggle when the voice says it. Tap it and the card steps aside, so you can do the gesture for real on the screen it is about. Your place is kept, and the tour carries on from the next card when you come back.

Tap Chat in Community and you're straight in the group chat, with no list of rooms first. Back takes you to the tab you came from, or out of Community. Your replies and mentions are one tap away in the Community menu.

The tutorial now talks you through by itself. Turn on its voice once and you can put your phone down: each card is read and the next one follows on its own, with a Pause button if you need a moment. The voice no longer reads a title that the text says again anyway. And the tutorial never opens the scanner any more, so no camera question can stop it: the Scan cards show you a picture of what is inside instead.

Community now opens straight on the tab you put first, without flashing the chat first. Creation and Affiliates no longer open blank. Inside a chat room, back (the arrow, swiping from the left edge or your phone's back) takes you to the channel list instead of leaving Community, and the round back button no longer sits on the Community logo. Chat rooms also use less memory.

Affiliate scripts can now be heard, not just read. Tap Listen to the script and the same natural voice as the tutorial reads it to you, scene by scene, with the line it is reading lit up, so you can listen and then say it to the camera. Tap again to pause, once more to carry on, or use the round arrow to start over. Every scene and the LOWiSPIKE day line also have their own small play button. In the free preview you hear scene 1.

Affiliates has a third track: LOWiSPIKE, a 30-day challenge, and it's free. Pick your day from 1 to 30 and the script shows that day's follow line, with the closing line on day 30. Copy the script and your day is already filled in.

In Affiliates, scene 1 of every paid script is now a free preview. The full script, the shot list and the caption open with the buyer code you get after buying, or with an invite code from the person who brought you in. Codes you already have still work. On the € page you can now see how recruits count: one active recruit counts like five sales, so three active recruits take you to level 3 before your first sale.

Affiliates now follows your app language: English, German or Spanish, scripts and shot lists included. Every screen has a share button at the top right that sends your own link, so whoever opens it lands on the same screen in the same language.

The bar at the bottom of the screen is gone, so the app has more room. Every page now has an X at the top left, and you can also swipe in from the left edge. Going back to Home is instant: nothing reloads, Misty and the bubbles stay where they were, and anything you had open on Home is still open.

Community feels calmer: a sliding pill for Room, Chat, Creation and Affiliates that stays at the top, every section opens at its start, and Creation and Affiliates now fit small iPhones, with easier-to-read text on iPad.

The robot voice is gone. Mirror mode, the workout voice cues, Audio mode, Learn while you move and the guide now speak with the same natural voice as the tutorial, in English, German and Spanish.

The Affiliates start screen no longer needs scrolling, even on small iPhones. The € button moved to the top bar and the text is shorter: get the script, record, earn.

Open a room in Community and it fills the screen: a back button, the room name in the middle and a members button on top, a pinned message under it, chat bubbles with the sender's name and the time inside. The photo button sits left of the message field, the mic or send button on the right. Everything is deep night blue with glowing brand-colour edges. Back takes you to the room list.

Your Community, your order: hold Room, Chat, Creation or Affiliates until the tabs wiggle, slide it where you want it and let go. LOWiSPIKE remembers the order, and Community always opens on your first tab. Cook and Move are gone from the bar at the bottom of Community, so it stays calm: Cook is on Home under Fuel, and holding Move on Home now opens the full Move page with your workouts, the Care board and today's moves (tap Edit to remove one).

On small iPhones like the SE, the tutorial card no longer cuts off long titles next to the speaker. Skip all can take two lines there, so the whole title fits.

The tutorial now walks you through every gesture and every part of the app in 70 steps: Home, Scan, flying and worlds, Misty's card, Community and Settings. In 17 steps you try the gesture yourself right there: tap, hold, drag, pinch, swipe and triple-tap. Settings now opens by holding the Community bubble. Start it any time from Settings.

New visitors now see what LOWiSPIKE is right away: "Eat smarter and lose weight, as a game." The start is 3 screens instead of 5, buttons say plainly what they do, and the account form only asks for email and password. Your shopping rhythm now reads "Once a week" instead of "Every 7 days".

No more reading: the tutorial reads itself to you. Tap the speaker on your companion's picture once, and every card is read aloud in a natural voice while the word being said lights up. Tap it again for quiet. The app remembers your choice.

"What can I buy here?" no longer shows up twice. It now lives in one place: Home, Fuel, then Shop. In Cook, Cook it and Shop it now lead straight into your recipes.

The Affiliates page is no longer cramped. It now shows one thing at a time: pick Webdesign or UGC, tap Start for the script, then see how to record it, then what you earn per level.

Deep analyze is a shortcut again. Open Scan, tap Deep analyze, and the LOWiSPIKE GPT opens in ChatGPT straight away: no photo step, no camera prompt, nothing piled up on screen. A product the barcode doesn't find gets the same one-tap link.

The tutorial card is cleaner: the dots are gone, and the step number at the top shows how far you are.

Home now says what its numbers mean. Fuel shows "1/3 meals", Gap says "no meal yet" until you log one, and the hours on the Gap planets say h. The Move picker asks "How far did you walk?", Today's stats says how many are on track, and Deep analyze tells you what you get: snap the pack and see if it will spike you.

The Affiliates page is now simple: pick Webdesign or UGC and get the ready video script with shot list and caption, then see what you earn per sale at each level (10 to 45 %). Your personal affiliate link comes from Eman on WhatsApp.

The Settings bubble on Home is now Community: tap it to meet everyone. Hold it to open a short Settings with only what you need: Day & night, Look, World sound, language, menu bar, Tutorial and your account, including Delete account. Your profile, Weight & BMI and places like For You, Care board, Workouts, World map, Gift of the day and Shopping hunt now sit in Community behind your picture, top right.

Fixing a food on a photo result is quicker: start typing in "What is it really?" and the app suggests products it already knows, from your scans, meals you logged before and the LOWiSPIKE product list, even with a typo ("Babybal" finds Babybel). Pick one and enter how many pieces you ate: the calories, the spike answer and your XP update right away.

Community Chat now opens a channel list with the newest messages, replies and your room.

Community has a new sleek header with a menu, readable tabs, and dark Creation and Affiliates pages.

Misty's Evolution path has a new look. Instead of ten tiny boxes, every form gets its own glass row on a glowing timeline, with its name, its form number and what it grew, in clear, easy-to-read type. The form you are on now glows, and the next one tells you how much XP is left. Forms you have not reached stay a mystery until you get there.

Community now has Creation and Affiliates tabs. Affiliates is the Master Blueprint: one video a day, with a ready script, shot list and checklist for the product you pick, plus your clicks, sales and commission tier. Creation is where the AI studio for videos and images is being built. Both also open as their own pages by link.

Your companion now changes its whole body as it grows: it starts as one glowing cell, learns to swim on long filament tails, becomes a many-armed reef spirit with a coral crown and ends as a giant celestial organism with organelles in orbit. Its face and colours stay the same the whole way. Forms you have not reached are no longer shown as shadows: they stay hidden until you get there.

The chat field comes first with camera and mic on its right, and the room name stays clear of the Day/Night switch.

Scan, Fuel and Gap each do one job now. Scan checks a product: Barcode, or Deep analyze, which reads a photo of the pack right in the app and tells you if it will likely spike. Fuel is where you log what you ate, and it asks when you ate, so a meal logged late counts from the right time. Saving a meal in Fuel closes your meal gap with its points, once. Gap just shows the time since your last meal on the six planets, with what typically happens along the way, and lets you fix the time if it is wrong.

Opening LOWiSPIKE no longer shows Misty and the LOWiSPIKE logo for a split second, and the screen is never white while it starts. From the first moment you see the dark background, then Home. If you still see white once, remove the app from your Home Screen and add it again.

Food photos now answer the spike question first. After Snap, the top of the screen says whether the meal spikes you, in big type. Below it, every food the photo found has its own card with a portion and calories: tap one to fix it, or add a drink, and the answer, the totals and the XP change with it. The XP you see is the XP you get. If a fast is running, the screen also says that saving ends it, with the points, the same line Log meal shows.

LOWiSPIKE opens straight to Home. The zoom from Misty's close-up at launch is gone, so the buttons don't slide around while you try to tap them. A slow or patchy connection no longer holds up opening the app: after a moment it opens the copy saved on your phone. Opening it again downloads less.

Eating is now one step. Log meal is the one place for it: snap a photo, type what you ate, or tap a recent meal. Saving it also ends a running fast, with its points and the +10 for logging the meal that broke it, so you no longer need to tap I just ate as well. Scan now has two buttons: Barcode to check a product, and Log meal. I just ate on Gap still works and opens the same Log meal, and nothing is counted twice.

Polish: the thin white edges on buttons, panels, the Community chat and the scanner now glow in the brand's cyan. Sharing the app link shows a LOWiSPIKE preview card, and the browser tab reads "LOWiSPIKE · Your health, played as a game". A wrong address now lands on a LOWiSPIKE page ("This page drifted out of orbit") with a button back to the app. The hint while flying Misty now fits on small phones instead of being cut off.

Fixes: swiping back in Safari closes the open sheet, then goes back to Today, instead of leaving and reloading the app (it used to happen inside Community). If a chat message can't be sent, the chat box now says so in plain words and keeps your text so you can tap send again, and being offline says so too and clears when you're back online.

Fixes: the Community chat box no longer stops responding when you come back to Community. Typing in Community no longer redraws the whole room on every letter, and the room shows the newest 60 messages with Show earlier messages for more. Holding Misty opens her card and it stays open. No connection now says so instead of 'Load failed'. Home no longer flashes the old layout after Settings > Today. Scanning says when it couldn't check a product instead of claiming it's unknown, and dark chocolate and watermelon are no longer counted as sugary drinks.

If you turned your phone while someone's companion was visiting on Home, their message could stay partly off the screen. Now it moves to the right spot.

When someone messages you and their companion appears on Home, it no longer disappears after a few seconds. It stays until you tap Reply or the x. If something covers Home for a moment, it comes back afterwards, and if more people wrote, the next one comes after you close it.

Settings now shows which version of the app you have, at the bottom next to the close button.

This small update only checks that new versions reach your phone. Everything else works as before.

If you added a photo to a new post and tapped Post right away, the app could hit an error in the background. And if you snapped a meal photo, closed the food screen and opened it again quickly, the old photo could pop up there. Now a photo only goes to the post or meal you picked it for.

If you sent a Community photo with a caption and started typing your next message while it was still sending, that message disappeared once the photo arrived. Now only the caption leaves the box, and whatever you typed in the meantime stays.

Mirror mode on the Move screen could leave your camera on. If you tapped "Without camera" while it was still starting, closed it and started again, or it couldn't load and you allowed the camera afterwards, the camera kept running in the background. Now the camera turns off every time you choose not to use it.

Searching for a product on the Scan tab twice in a row, or fixing a typo and searching again, used to open the results twice, stacked, so you had to close them twice. Now you only ever see the results of your newest search. And when you add a new product and quickly scan the next one, the next product's card no longer gets the old product's celebration painted on it.

If you closed your companion's card and held them again straight away, or closed Glow and tapped it again quickly, nothing opened. Now it opens every time. With a keyboard (an iPad with a keyboard case), Escape after closing Glow now closes your companion's card too, and Escape and Tab keep working after you tap a mood or pick a glow colour. VoiceOver also stays on the button you just used instead of jumping to the top of the page.

Every food photo left two copies of the picture in your phone's memory, about 8 MB, and every barcode scan and Community photo left more. iOS only clears those copies when it gets round to it, so a few photos and scans in a row could pile up until it closed the app. Now each copy is thrown away the moment your photo or scan is done. Your photos look exactly the same.

From Nova on, the standard Misty drew her face outside her body and lost her stem and her Legendary glow. She now keeps her Legendary shape and sparkle at every form after it. And if the app reloaded or closed while an evolution was waiting or playing, you never saw it. Now it plays the next time you open the app.

Food is simpler: Log meal is for what you ate, Shop has Scan in the shop and your Shopping list, and a shopping scan never logs a meal. Tapping I just ate on Gap opens the same meal logger, and you can skip it. Scan a product nobody has added yet and you can be its Pathfinder: your name stays on it, you get bonus XP, and your badge counts every product you found first.

The glow colour you pick in Glow now shows on your companion right away, on Home and on their card, and it follows you to your other devices. You can also give your companion a name of your own: hold them and tap Rename under their name.

When someone writes to you in Community while you're on Home, their own companion now flies into your world, appears like a hologram and shows you the message. Tap it to open the message in Community and reply, or tap the x to let them go. Only messages to you come by, one person at a time.

Sending something kind to a friend is now free: no more sparks to count or run out of. Each kind still goes once a day per friend.

Long press your companion: Forms and your new Food journal are right at the top, the Food journal shows the foods you tried and how those meals went, and adventure places now open once you've flown there yourself and the level is reached. The places have plain, clear names now.

Your companion now has ten forms instead of six. After Legendary come Nova, Titan, Monarch and Majesty, each with something new: a mane and a gold crown, twin tails and a third pair of wings, power spikes and a second pair of horns, and at the top a ring of stars with golden edges. Your companion keeps its own look and every bit of progress. Hold your companion and tap Forms to see the whole path.

With lots of people in Community, the app redrew every companion and every chat message several times a minute, even when nothing had changed. On a phone that could use up enough memory for iOS to close the app while you scrolled the chat or sent energy. Now only what is new gets drawn. And the "sent you energy" messages are gone from the chat: the burst says it.

Every time you zoomed from Home out to Community or back, the light streaks were drawn on a new full-screen picture, and the old ones stayed in your phone's memory for a while. Zooming in and out a few times could pile them up until iOS closed the app. Now each one is thrown away the moment the zoom ends, and on iPad it is a quarter of the size.

Energy bursts play like billiards now. Whoever you hit rolls away, knocks into the companions in their path and stays where they stop. Nobody slides back to their old spot any more, not even after you leave Community or reopen the app.

You told us it wasn't fun when everyone you shot just came back.

In Spanish, the welcome now names the Move bubble the way Home does (Movimiento), and the setup note about health conditions reads naturally.

A Spanish speaker told us the first steps read like word-for-word English. We rewrote the Spanish in the welcome, sign-up, setup and companion reveal, the shopping step and the meal photo checks. The food scanner now says in Spanish whether a food will likely raise your blood sugar, and your companion is no longer called "tu hierba".

If the app reloaded or closed while your companion was coming to life in setup, before you tapped Continue, you never got it back and kept the standard Misty instead. Now setup comes back at your birthday, already filled in, so you can bring your own companion to life.

If the app reloaded or closed while the few questions after setup were open, they were gone for good and you never got your next steps. Now they come back the next time you open the app, until you tap Let’s do it or Not now.

Tap Log meal and pick Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner or Snacks, then write it, scan it or snap it. Each one remembers what you usually eat, so the same meal is one tap. In Shop there's a new Snacks to buy list, only for snacks you still need. Tick them when they're in your bag.

Your companion is your investment, and now you can see it grow. Each new form is clearly more powerful than the last: the little fins turn into big, heavy ones, stone armour builds up from 2 stones to 9, and later forms get wings, horns and a crown. The first evolution comes on day one, the next within a few days. The evolution moment gets bigger every time too: your companion charges up, flashes and bursts into the new form, with more light each tier. It's still your own companion, with its own colours, name and face.

Open Settings, then Weight & BMI. Enter your weight (and your height once) and you get your BMI with its range, plus an estimate of your body fat from your BMI, age and sex. It's an estimate, not a measurement. Every weigh-in goes on your track: a Then and Now picture, how many kilos you've moved, and a level that goes up with every kilo toward the healthy range. Your weight stays on this phone.

Shooting energy at each other in Community for a long time could overload a phone. Community now does less work while balls fly, keeps the hit sparkles to a fixed amount, and draws a lighter version when your phone slows down.

New accounts now get the tour by themselves, right after setup, once Home is ready. It explains almost every little part in short cards: each bubble, energy and mood, the joystick, zoom and autopilot, worlds, Scan and the 3 photo checks, Forms and the care room, Community, chat and sending energy, the Day card and Settings. Skip jumps past a part, Skip all ends it. Left halfway? You get one offer to continue. Replay it any time in Settings, Tutorial.

If the app reloaded or closed after your birthday step, the rest of setup was skipped for good. Now setup comes back and continues with the next step.

Your food now has stats. Scan a product and right under the spike estimate you see your portion: "Last time 200 g", or the usual portion the first time, with protein, fiber, sugar, carbs, fat and calories for exactly that amount. Tap + or - or type a number and the values change with it. Tap Ate it and next time the card remembers how much you had.

Tap Today's stats on that card, at the top of Log meal, or hold Fuel on Home. Your day shows up like character stats: Strength is protein, Defense is fiber, Stamina is carbs, Reserve is fat, Power is calories, and Spike guard is your sugar limit. Each bar shows what's left. When every stat is on track, you can go to bed with a clear conscience.

Tap Set my targets to use your own numbers. If your doctor gave you a sugar limit, put it in, and Spike guard shows how much sugar you have left today.

After you scan a product, the card now shows the spike estimate, then where it's cheaper at other stores, then Catch it, and the Details are already open underneath. Community deals and Post a deal moved further down, with the spike lists at the very end, clear of the close button.

The tutorial no longer flickers. It was mistaking its own card for another panel, so it kept hiding and coming back. Open Settings and tap Tutorial: each card now stays steady until you tap Next, Back or Skip.

Lost track of all the updates? Open Settings and tap Tutorial. Your companion walks you through everything from the beginning, as if you were new: the Home bubbles, energy, Scan and Snap food, Forms, worlds and autopilot, Community and Settings. Nothing you've tracked is touched. Tap Skip to jump past a part, or Skip all to end it. Every new update keeps the tutorial up to date.

Chat in Community is now a real room. Tap Chat and it opens full screen like a star chart: glass messages lit in each person's colour, Today and Yesterday markers, and the people who spoke recently at the top. Tap one to see their card. The header shows how many people talked in the last 24 hours and whether the room is live. The back arrow takes you out again.

After Snap food reads your plate, tick "Also share to Community" and your post gets the meal name, the estimated ingredients and nutrition, and its likely blood sugar response underneath. That last one is an estimate from the photo, not a measurement. Everyone gets 3 photo checks a day, for Snap food and Community together, and sharing a photo that was already read doesn't use another one. Typing what you ate is always unlimited. You can also turn on reminders to snap your meals, under Reminders.

If the daily Day card was already open when setup or another panel opened, it stayed on top, so tapping Next hit the card instead. Now the Day card steps aside when something else opens, and comes back once you're done.

The companion you met in setup, with its own shape, colours, eyes and accessory, is now the one you see on Home, in Forms and in flight. Before, Home switched back to the standard Misty.

A brand-new companion used to wake up tired, because nothing was tracked yet. Now a new account starts at 100% for its first day: she flies faster, the world moves livelier and shines brighter, and her sparkles turn gold. Over the first day this welcome energy fades and what you track keeps her up. The lower her energy, the slower and heavier everything feels.

A new account no longer shows a fast it never did. Until you log a meal, the Gap bubble shows a dash. Tap Gap and say when you last ate, or just log a meal, and the clock starts from that meal. A clock that's already running isn't changed.

Log meal now understands what you type. "Chicken stew" is chicken stew, not just chicken, and "fish and chips" or "spaghetti bolognese" get their own ingredients. Every meal gets an estimate for calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber and sugar from USDA food data, so you never see "not provided" again. Your own numbers always win. The Log meal panel is simpler too: type your meal, tap one you ate recently, or pick one of Misty's suggestions. Snap food and scanning products are in Scan.

If a new update arrives while you're still setting up, or answering your starter plan questions, it now waits until you're done. Before, the update bubble could pop up right over your answers.

When you opened the lung world from the World map, Misty never came in. Puff the air sac talked away to an empty world. Now Misty swims into the lungs by herself, just like in every other world, and you can steer her there and fly her back out.

Flying in and out of worlds no longer crashes the app. Every time Misty left a world, the app kept a full-size picture of the last frame, and on iPhone and iPad these piled up until the app ran out of memory and restarted. The picture is now small and thrown away right after the fade, so you can fly in and out as often as you like.

On a small phone held sideways, Home used to drop the bubble ring and show the old layout with the tab bar and the Daily Quest card. Now Misty gets a little smaller to fit the screen height, and all eight bubbles stay around her.

Setup fits on smaller iPhone screens, so Misty's speech bubble no longer covers the back button. Your Gap goal now follows what you answered in the starter plan: if you said you never fast, it starts at 12 hours, not 16. Setup and VoiceOver now use the same names as your bubbles, Fuel and Gap. And on your first days, Misty's "Drag to look around" tip appears at the top of the screen instead of hiding behind your bubbles.

The last old companion drawings are gone. On the friends tree, in the friend card, the More friends list, the invite card and in Community chat, friends are now the same glass cell as Misty, carrying their own form, or simply tinted in their own colour if they don't share one. The little old blob with a smile is gone. Inside your cell, you're the real Misty too.

Now and then, right after a lesson, a guide makes a little joke about another guide. Each one is a real bit of body science: Hexa grumbles that Isla bosses her around with glucagon, Puff reminds Pulse who fills his blood with oxygen. Never the same line twice in a row.

More old looks are gone. On the friends tree, your own spot now shows Misty exactly as she looks on Home, instead of an older cell drawing, and no small blob gets painted over her. The old care room, its dock button and the level-up card also draw her current glass cell, never the potted herb from the first version.

The app icon is now Misty in her glass bubble instead of the old pulse-line logo. The launch screen shows a blue Misty cell instead of the old gold ball. In Community, your own bubble and your chat picture are the real Misty, not an old little blob. The old photo sign-up screen is gone; your details live in Profile. To get the new icon on your home screen, remove the app from the home screen and add it again.

Inside a world, switching the language used to make the guide start over: it said welcome back again and jumped to the next lesson, so you missed the one you were reading. Now it says the same line again in the new language. Guides also never re-tell a lesson from an earlier visit (they ask "Remember?" instead), and they call your companion Misty.

When you tapped Move, its little note ("Estimate, not steps") sat on top of the Move bubble itself and partly covered the Medium and Long choices. Now it never covers a bubble or a choice: when there's no room next to the choices, it moves to the top of the screen.

When you changed the language in Settings, part of Home stayed in the old language until you closed and reopened the app: Move, Scan, Settings, Sleep, the fasting timer and what VoiceOver reads for the bubbles and the joystick. Now everything switches right away, and inside a world the guide switches too.

After you log something, Misty's praise line (like "I'm so proud of you!") used to sit on top of Settings, Hydration and Fuel for a few seconds. Now it never covers a bubble or the joystick: when there's no room next to Misty, it moves to the top or bottom of the screen.

On Home, Misty's short notes (like "My sun is full! Peek in Today.") sat on top of Settings, Hydration and Fuel, and a tap on the top of those bubbles opened Today instead. Now a note never covers a bubble or the joystick: when there's no room above Misty, it moves to the top or bottom of the screen.

When Misty rides a string on autopilot, the camera now shrinks down behind her, like Ant-Man, and looks the way she's travelling. The string under her becomes a huge glowing glass cable, and the bubbles ahead loom about twice as big. She travels just as fast as before. When she leaves the string, the camera grows back out to the normal view in one smooth move, with no loading screen. With Reduce Motion on, the camera stays as it was.

Inside a world, the guide's speech bubble used to sit on the joystick for a few seconds while it talked. Now it never covers it: when there's no room beside the guide, the bubble moves to the top or bottom of the screen.

On autopilot, Misty now tours the spirit world along its strings. She hooks onto a string, drifts along it to a bubble she hasn't seen, looks round it, and changes strings to reach the next one. She only flies on her own when no string leads to a bubble she still wants to see. She no longer gets pulled into a bubble twice in a row, and she no longer hangs still on a string between two bubbles that sit close together.

Leaving a world is now a rocket launch. It's slower, and the camera rides out with Misty: the climb is heavy and shaky, with the world below and space above, while she fights the pull through the rings. Then she breaks free, everything goes calm, and the camera swings round to look back down at the world falling away. When Misty is low on energy, the rings can pull her back in, and she'll tell you about it. Try again and she gets out. The X and the World map always take you straight out.

Cell guides now check what you remember. On some return visits the guide asks about something it told you before, with Yes and No glass buttons right in its speech bubble. Tap Yes and it moves on to a new lesson. Tap No and it tells you that lesson again. The question waits until Misty has swum in, and it never sits on Misty or the joystick.

Settings opens as a glass panel beside Misty now, in the same style as the sound panel, so Misty and Home stay in view. Everything is still there: Me, Look & sound, Account, the Menu bar switch, and More with Community, Care board, Workouts, World map and the rest. The X at its bottom right closes it. World sound now opens the sound panel in front, where you can use it, instead of behind Settings.

The joystick is a plain white icon now, and it disappears while you steer. The small glass circle with a silver rim inside it is gone, so it looks like the other bubbles: just a white icon in the glass. Forward, back and autopilot tint the icon instead of drawing a ring. When you steer for about a second and a half without lifting your thumb, it disappears completely and keeps working under your thumb. Lift your thumb and it comes straight back. This works on Home and inside worlds.

Bubbles no longer have shadows. The glass cells had a shaded arc on one side, and Misty had an oval under her that looked like a shadow on a floor that isn't there. Both are gone, on Home, in flight and inside worlds. The glass rims, colours and glow stay.

Each little guide in the cell worlds says hello and its name only the very first time you meet it. After that it greets you with a short welcome back, like "Oh, you're back!" or "Back to business, then.", never the same one twice in a row, and goes on with something it hasn't told you yet.

Leaving a world now plays the way in, backwards. Misty used to pop out next to a zoomed-out view. Now you start right up close, where the world's colour fills the screen, and pull back through its rings like passing a planet up close, while Misty rises out of it. You end looking at the world from outside, with Misty just above it.

Every speech bubble now stays up for as long as it takes to read it: Misty's lines, the cell guides inside the worlds, and the small notices. Longer lines stay longer, and a new line no longer pushes one away before you've read it. Tap the guide for its next line, or tap its bubble to close it.

One tap on Settings now opens one page with everything in it: Me, Look & sound, Account and the Menu bar switch, then More with Community, Care board, Workouts, World map and the rest. No more second panel. The X at the bottom right takes you back home.

The joystick goes see-through while you steer. Your thumb used to cover Misty and the world. Now, while you drag the joystick or hold it to fly forward or back, it fades so you can see what's underneath, and it keeps steering her the whole time. Let go and it comes right back. This works inside worlds too.

Tapping Fuel now shows three choices: Shop, Cook and Log meal. Swap is gone, and so is Today's step. Log meal is now a button you can see, so you no longer have to hold Fuel to log a meal (holding still works).

The X in the scanner is now at the bottom right, next to Deep analyze. It used to sit at the top left of the camera, far from your thumb. The flash stays at the top right, and scanning a barcode, Snap food, Log meal and typing a barcode number work exactly as before. Nothing else changed.

Inside a world the joystick is back, and so is the way out. Since the new Home with the ring of bubbles, entering a world hid the joystick and the World map button too, so you couldn't steer Misty or leave. Now the joystick stays in its place in a world and steers her as usual. To leave, tap the World map button at the bottom right; if you were just steering, tap empty space once first so it shows. Pushing against the world's edge still flies you out too.

Misty looks like herself again while flying — only her eyes stay solid. Out of her bubble she has her own glassy colour again, a little see-through when she's tired, instead of the pale white glow from the last update. Her eyes, their sparkle, her pink cheeks and her smile are always drawn fully solid whenever her face points at you, so they never fade into a dark world.

The joystick is now a glass bubble like the other seven around Misty. It used to be a dark blue disc with a blue arc, a dashed circle and a grey knob, so it looked like a different control. Now it has the same clear wobbly glass, rim and shine as Scan, Sleep and Settings, at home and inside worlds, and its knob is a small glass bubble too. The knob turns mint on autopilot and still lights up when you drag forward or back. It steers exactly as before, and its size and place in the circle are unchanged. Misty's energy still shows in her colour and face.

Settings > More (Everything else) now lists only what no bubble already reaches. Go to: Community, Care board, Workouts, World map, VR, Gift of the day and Weather. Settings: World sound. Cook is in the Fuel bubble, Day and night is in Settings > Look & sound, and Today and Daily quest are gone from Home. The panel is glass like the bubbles, opens beside the circle on iPad and right under Misty on iPhone, never covers her, fits without scrolling, and Back and × always stay at the top.

The dark shadow under every bubble on Home is gone. Scan, Sleep, Settings and the joystick no longer cast a shadow below them, Misty has no dark shadow under her, and the grey oval on her name line is gone. The bubbles keep their shine at the top, their rim and their labels.

Settings is now at the top of the circle and Scan sits at the lower right, where Settings used to be. Everything else stays where it was: the same eight round controls, all the same size and evenly spaced around Misty, with the joystick at the bottom. Scan still opens the scanner, and Settings still opens Me, Look & sound, Account, the menu bar switch and More, now fanning out above the circle without covering Misty.

The water in the bubbles now fits the bubble: on Home, the colour inside Water, Move, Gap, Fuel and Sleep was a flat circle drawn on top of the wobbly glass, so it poked past the edge in some places and left gaps in others. Now the glass draws its own water, so it has exactly the same outline, wobbles with it and sloshes when the bubble moves or you tap it, like water in a balloon. A full bubble is full to the brim: Water at 6 of 6 cups or more fills the whole glass. How full each bubble is has not changed, and your data, XP and level are untouched.

Misty's eyes now stay visible while she flies. Her body used to turn see-through out in the world, more so when she was tired, so her face faded into dark places. Now her body stays solid behind her face, and her face is drawn fully whenever she looks your way. When she flies away from you, you see her back, and her face turns smoothly out of view. At home she looks the same as before.

Fuel, Water, Move and Gap now open their own choices around Misty. Tapping a bubble only opens it, so nothing gets logged by accident. Fuel: Today's step, Snack (what can I buy here?), Swap for a craving, and Cook; hold Fuel for your meal log. Water: +1 cup, and Undo takes a cup back along with its points. Move: Quick, Medium, Long or Epic; hold Move to see or remove today's moves. Gap: the time since your last meal, with I just ate and Ate earlier. The choices fan out away from Misty, never cover her or each other, and only one bubble is open at a time, Sleep and Settings included.

Sleep and Settings on Home now work for real. Tap Sleep and choose how long you slept last night: under 6 h, 6–7 h or 7 h or more. The bubble fills a third, two thirds or all the way, and you can change or clear today's answer any time today. Your sleep stays private on this phone, with your other health notes. It gives no XP yet. A sleep note from the first version (Good, Okay or Short) is not carried over, so just log today again.
