Tap Settings for Me, Look & sound, Account, the bottom menu bar switch and More, which lists everything that used to sit on Home. The choices open out of the bubble and never cover Misty.

A new one-page Home: Misty sits in the middle with eight round controls on one circle around her, all the same size. Scan is at the top and the joystick at the bottom. Around her are Fuel (your meals), Water, Move, Gap (the time between meals), Sleep and Settings. Tap Scan to scan a product. Tap Sleep to note how you slept. Settings holds everything that used to sit on Home: your profile, Today, Daily quest, the world map, VR, sound, day and night, the gift of the day, weather and the other tabs. It also has a switch that brings back the bottom menu bar if you like it.

Move and Meals stay by their bubbles: on iPad and computers, tapping Move sent Quick, Medium, Long and Epic toward the middle of the screen, right on top of Misty, and the Meals panel opened in the middle over her too. Now the four Move choices fan out of the Move bubble on the side away from Misty, always fully on screen. The Meals panel, and the lists you get by holding Move or Meals, open beside Misty on the bubble's side (or above her when the iPad is upright) instead of covering her. On a phone the Move choices also stay off Misty; the Meals sheet on a phone is unchanged. Nothing else changed, and your data, XP and level are untouched.

Cleaner bubbles on Today: some pieces of the old design were still drawn inside the new glass bubbles. Misty's thin energy ring with its little tick lines, the short white dashes on the fasting bubble's rim, the hard white line across its water and a red rim inside Misty's glass are gone. Nothing you see is lost: Misty's energy still shows as a % next to her name (her whole scale is in her card), the fasting bubble still fills with water and shows your time, and her glass still turns reddish when she is low.

Truer grocery picks: "What can I buy here?" now follows the lowiSPIKE way more closely. Potato salad, fries, crisps, ready rice, muesli and sweetcorn were counted as low-starch vegetables or tiny handfuls, so some showed as Good. Now they are rated as the starchy foods they are, by a real plate, and are left out. Cake, churros, pancakes and ice-cream bars are rated by a real slice or bar, not a 25 g bite. Zero colas and energy drinks still pass, but they are Good, not Best: water and plain tea are Best. These are estimates from the label, not medical advice.

Owner tools: the app owner can now kick members out of Community and remove test accounts. Kick hides someone from Community and the care board and stops them posting, and it can be undone. Delete removes an account for good after typing DELETE. Nobody else sees these buttons, and the server checks every request. They switch on once the owner finishes the Supabase setup.

Lighter What can I buy here?: after Cook, then What can I buy here? reset the app on an iPhone, the list now opens with 15 products per category instead of 40, and Show more adds 40 at a time instead of putting every product of a category on screen at once. The 3D world behind it pauses while the list is open and carries on when you close it. Ratings, filters, photos and the quick view are unchanged.

Product photos in What can I buy here?: every product now has a small photo next to its Best or Good tag, and you can tap it. A window opens with a bigger photo, the label, why it is rated Best or Good, and a link to its product page. The photos and lists come from Open Food Facts, where shoppers add products and tag which chain sells them, so a product may not be on the shelf of your shop today. Products nobody has photographed yet say No photo yet.

Quieter in the background: the world's mood tint, the daily ritual ring, the living-home light and the gift button kept setting the same value again every second or two, even while the app was in the background. Each time, the rest of the app woke up to check. Now they only change when something really changes. Nothing looks different, and your data, XP and level are untouched.

Misty stays close on her trips: when she explores inside a world, she no longer stays tiny the whole time. She lands small, flies up close to you, and only now and then drifts off into the distance for a few seconds before coming back. When you steer her she always stays close. Spiralling into a world still makes her small, like before.

No more test accounts: Emma, Gatey, Guesty, Test, QA and two fake "eman" accounts are hidden from Community and the Care board. Real people and the three demo bots stay. Nothing was deleted.

Calmer Home: the Daily Quest board, the water bubble and a few buttons on Home kept rewriting themselves with the same words about twice a second, and every rewrite woke the rest of the app. That was strongest right after you came back to the app. Now they only change when something really changes. Nothing looks different, and your data, XP and level are untouched.

Care board shows you once: other accounts with your name (test sign-ups) no longer appear next to you, and two accounts with the same name show as one person, like in Community. Friends show up once they have sunbeams in the new app this week or month.

Crash and heat fix: after you opened Community or Cook, a few labels kept rewriting themselves without changing, and that woke the rest of the app on every frame. It kept going on Home, and even with the screen off. That's the most likely cause of the lag, the warm phone and the reloads when zooming out in Community. Now those labels only update when their words actually change. Nothing else changed, and your data, XP and level are untouched.

Less data and less work in the background: the app checks for a new version once a minute. Until now, each check downloaded every What's New note ever written, about 67 KB over the network (185 KB once unpacked), which added up to roughly 4 MB an hour on mobile data. Now each check reads only the first 64 bytes, where the version number sits. Updates still show up within a minute, and nothing else changed.

Crash fix: the app no longer heats up and crashes after you open the Care board. A small line on the Move card kept rewriting itself many times a second, which made the whole app slow and could crash Safari, even after you left Move. It now updates only when your sunbeams change. Nothing about your data, XP or level changed.

Care board and Misty's growth: the old leaderboard is now a care board. It shows who looks after their companion best: meals, water, Moves and scans give Misty sunbeams, and eating less never counts. Switch between this week and this month. Tap a level to see Misty's growth: what each level really gives her, like her new form, how far her adventures go and new glows for her bubble. The old VIP, course and mentoring rewards that nobody could reach are gone. Your XP, level and finds stay exactly as they were.

Your own shopping rhythm and a fresher start. Healthy days start in the grocery shop, so setup now asks how often you usually shop: you type your own number of days, and can add your usual days and shop if you like, or tap Later. Your shopping glow follows that number. Already set up? Find it in Profile, About you, Grocery shopping, and change it any time. Missing a shop never counts against you. New players also get a short How you play screen (controller, three taps for autopilot, bubbles, the cell and spirit worlds, and barcode scanning, which gives an estimate, not a promise).

Water now counts cups. Each tap on the water bubble is one cup, and the daily goal is 6 cups, shown as 0/6 cups just like Meals and Move. The bubble fills up as you go and is full at 6. You can keep tapping after that, the count goes on, but the water XP stops at the goal. Long press still resets today's count. It's a simple daily habit goal, not a medical target, so drink when you're thirsty.

Shopping hunt: healthy days start at the shop. Scan the barcode of two different good products, or take a photo, and you have checked in from the shop: your world and your own world in the spirit realm glow brighter for a while, then slowly fade back to normal. It never goes below normal and never judges what you eat. Pick your shop and you see what other shoppers found there as little glimmers to catch. Catch foods that belong together on one trip, like quark, kiwi and almonds, and you get a power combo with a burst of light and extra XP. You can build your own combos, pause while you are away, and a photo always works when a barcode won't scan. Photos stay on your phone and nothing about your location is saved. Open it from Scan a product with the Hunt button.

Not feeling a quest today? The Daily Quest now has a small Skip button above the quest name, so you can choose Start or Skip. A skipped quest steps aside and the next one comes up. It earns no XP and does not count toward the six, and the all-six bonus still needs it, but you can still do it today: if you move later, it counts as done. Tap Start on it, or Undo skip, to bring it back. Skips reset at midnight with the quests.

Community now has just three bots, and they show how a companion grows: Mateo at level 1 with a newborn companion, Jonas at level 18, halfway grown, and Samir at level 43, fully grown. They are the same three everywhere in Community, on the leaderboard and in the chat, and each one is marked as a bot in their profile. Mila, Theo, Kenji and the other made-up members are gone.

What can I buy here? A new emergency button under Meals, Cook it and Shop it shows every insulin-friendly product a shop sells, grouped into snacks, meat, fish, dairy, cheese, vegetables, fruit, bread, sweets, drinks and more, best picks first, each with its reason. Pick a shop near you or a chain to look before you go. Føtex, Bilka and Danish Netto use Salling Group's real online range; EDEKA, REWE, Lidl, Aldi, Kaufland, Netto, Penny and famila use Open Food Facts. Each product is rated by glycemic load per portion from its label. General food guidance, not medical advice.

Misty's timed adventure now explores like autopilot, and how far she goes depends on her level. Level 1 and 2: her home world, visiting each place's door. Level 3: she also flies into the cell worlds. Level 4: she breaks out and drifts round the spirit world's outer sky. Level 5: she goes inside its bubbles. Level 6: she rides the streams from bubble to bubble on her own. Autopilot (three quick taps on the controller) is a separate choice and always goes everywhere, whatever her level. Her Misty card shows what is unlocked, and the trip sheet says how far this trip reaches.

You can now call Misty back from her exploration whenever you like. While she is out, the timer in her empty bubble says "Tap to call her back": one tap and she flies straight home into her bubble, brings her find with her, and you have her back on the controller. The same button is in the sun panel. Her next trip is tomorrow, and the world keeps the glow she gave it so far.

No more in-between when Misty leaves a world. Out of a cell world, and out of the main world, she goes straight from inside to outside: one moment she is in the world, the next she is outside next to its bubble, while the inside softly fades away. The light streaks, the big glowing disc and ring, the flat colour screen and the purple sheet are gone. The flat blue screen had a real cause: when the camera pulled back, the whole live world was faded out by mistake. That is fixed, so the world now stays on screen.

Holding forward no longer puts a constant light in front of Misty. Instead she pushes against her own stretchy bubble skin, just like when she pushes out of her first bubble: it stretches out ahead of her the way she is flying, a little further as she gets going, and wobbles back when you let go. It tilts with the controller, so you can still see where she is heading, and when you back up it stretches behind her. The energy shot stays exactly as it was (hold the controller and double tap with a second finger), and now it punches out through her skin.

Every panel now opens like Move. Tap Fasting, Meals, the weather, Today or the sound button and the panel grows out of the spot you touched, like a small bubble stretching open, and shrinks back into it when you close it. It floats as one of Misty's see-through bubbles with the world still visible behind it. The quick choices are round bubbles that pop in one after another, like Move's Quick to Epic: the times in End your fast, Snap food and Scan a product, and the weather readings. The main button glows mint like a filled Move bubble. Everything inside still works the same.

Out in the spirit world, holding the controller still (forward) now flies Misty into another world's bubble, just like steering into it with the stick. Before, only the stick counted, so the forward hold bounced off every bubble and slid round it. A steady push now also gets through when the glass nudges her back a little.

Touching the world no longer brings the menus back while Misty flies. On autopilot or while you steer, drag the world round, hold it or pinch it, and the clean view stays: no panels, no menu bar. Only a quick, still tap on Home's own world brings everything back, and that tap does nothing else. Out in the spirit world a tap never brings the panels back: on autopilot it only brings back the controller, so you can take over.

Misty stays busy when she flies out of a world on autopilot. On the way out she looks where she's going instead of turning to stare at you, and once she's out she heads straight for her next stop instead of drifting and waiting. When she gets lost far out, she swims in little loops instead of just hanging there. If you tapped inside a world, leaving it no longer brings up all of Home's menus by surprise. Only the controller you tapped back stays, and one tap on Home brings the rest.

Flying far out no longer drops Misty back in her bubble. If you keep holding one way past the deep dark, she now comes round beside home and keeps flying into new space, instead of straight back into her bubble. Letting go of the stick to turn the view around no longer counts as doing nothing, so she stays out there while you look. A drag from the screen edge while she flies now turns the view instead of switching pages. And switching apps for a moment, or the phone briefly taking the 3D graphics away, now pauses her where she is instead of starting over.

Now the cell guide glows in the dark, not Misty. Deep in a world's dark zone, the little guide flying next to Misty lights up for a split second every 3 seconds, with a soft light that shows just what is right around the two of you. Misty herself stays dark. The faint warm glow of the world you came from is still there, and the dark is still nearly black.

On autopilot, turning the world now shows Misty from a new side. Inside a world, her path stays where it is in the world, so when you drag the world round you see her side, her front or her back from your new angle, and she no longer keeps the same side to you. If your turn carries her goal out of view, she picks a new one in view. And when she has been flying away from you for a while, she now looks back over her shoulder at you for a moment, then flies on. When you steer her yourself, nothing changes.

On autopilot inside a world, the controller now fades out completely, together with its little mode line, so it's just Misty and the world. When you steer her yourself it stays, and one tap still brings it back so you can take over.

Lost in the dark? Look for home. When you fly Misty far out into a world's dark zone, the world you came from now glows very faintly where it really is, in a dim warm light. Even when it is off the edge of the screen, the side facing it is a touch less black. It is only a hint, not an arrow: the dark stays nearly black, the guide still glows every 3 seconds, and finding your way back is still up to you.

Inside a world it's just you, Misty and the world now. The menu, the side bar, the greeting, the weather, the Daily Quest, Today and the buttons no longer show up in there, not even when you tap. Misty, her guide and the controller stay, and the World map button is still there to take you back. Outside the worlds, everything keeps the soft water look from Home instead of the old flat boxes.

The black holes are gone. Nothing pulls Misty in or traps her any more. Where the cloud wall round a world has its dark gaps, the world now opens onto the dark, and you can always fly in there. The deeper you go, the darker everything gets, until you and Misty can hardly see a thing, as if you had flown out of the game. Every 3 seconds her cell guide glows for a split second, so you know you are still there and nothing froze. Steer back and the light comes back. The dark is never a way out. Only the cloud wall is: push into it and its thin glass bubble skin bulges out around her, like Home's edge when she leaves for the spirit world.

Misty no longer stares at you all the time. Out in the world she turns her whole round body to look where she is flying: fly her sideways and you see her face in profile, fly her away and you see her back, fly her up and her face tips to her top. When you steer, she faces the way you turned her, and backing up she keeps facing forward. On autopilot and while she circles a world before going in, she looks along her path. When she rests, she looks around on her own and only now and then glances back at you. Her turns are smooth, never a snap.

Misty now meets the blood cells floating around her. Out in the bloodstream at Home a cell can really bump into her, only when it is truly at her depth, not when it just passes in front of her or behind her. She gets knocked a little, the cell tumbles off into a new lane, and she goes funny and dizzy: she tips over, sways woozily for a moment, braces herself and steadies back up. On autopilot she sometimes spots a cell coming and swerves, sometimes she does not; now and then she drifts over to look at a passing cell. When you steer, she never swerves by herself. After a bump things stay calm for a few seconds, so there is no pinball. No XP, energy or anything else changes.

Beyond your world, every bubble you find can now be visited. Fly Misty against one and keep pushing in for a moment: its skin gives, she slips inside, and the camera comes in close so its glowing walls are all around her. Push against the wall from inside for a moment to get out again. The light strings between those bubbles are ocean currents now: fly close to one and it carries Misty along, fast with the flow, slow and hard work against it; steer sideways to leave it. Autopilot and the way home are never pulled off course, and none of this gives XP.

Home is zoomed out now. When you open the app, the camera starts close to Misty and gently pulls back, so you see more of her world with Misty in the middle. Her four bubbles, Meals, Move, Water and Fasting, slowly circle around her like Dragon Balls. They stop the moment you touch one, so tapping and long pressing work exactly as before. Pinch in any time to come close again. With your phone on its side they stay in their usual spots.

Ways out: inside a world, the soft cloud wall at its edge, in Misty's own blue, violet and cyan, is the way out. Fly her into it and keep pushing for 3 seconds: the wall stretches where she presses, Home's light shows through behind it, then it bursts open and you both fly out. The autopilot heads for the cloud wall, and World map always brings you home. Misty's guide and hints stay quiet while she travels between worlds.

Misty's controller now stays put. Out in the world, while you steer, on autopilot or inside a world, it keeps its spot on the screen instead of moving around with Misty or the camera, so your thumb always finds it in the same place. It only moves when you turn your phone or iPad, and then it stays put again. Everything you do with it works the same.

Energy shot: while one finger holds Misty's controller, dragging or held still in the middle, tap the world twice quickly with another finger (or tap Misty twice). She shoots a ball of energy the way she is aiming: straight ahead, or up and down with the controller. Where it lands inside a world, the world heals a little and its murk and fog thin. It needs a moment to charge between shots, and each world can only be healed so much a day, so it can't be farmed. It never gives XP or crumbs. Without a finger on the controller, a double tap works exactly as before.

Meals is one simple thing now. Tap the Meals bubble and the Log a meal sheet opens with everything in it. Long press it to see today's meals, and letting go after the long press no longer opens a second sheet. The bubble holds its spot instead of creeping around. The Daily Quest no longer asks you to log a meal right next to the Meals bubble: it suggests your other quests first, its meal button opens the same Meals sheet, and a meal you log in the bubble counts for the quest too, once. Past the edges that give way there are no walls any more. New worlds keep appearing the farther you fly, and you can fly right into them. Let go for a while and Misty always finds her way home.

Smoother bubbles: the outlines of Misty's bubble, every Home bubble (Fasting, Water, Move, Meals, VR, Sound, World map, Day/Night, Today, the weather and the Daily Quest) and the other worlds out in the universe are smooth now instead of jagged and pixely, also when your phone is warm or in Low Power Mode. The wide Daily Quest and Today drops have rounder corners too. It costs no extra battery: the bubbles stay as alive as before, only their edges are cleaner. The menu bar stays as it was. The little cell guide stays with Misty now. When the menus fade while she flies, on autopilot or while you steer, the guide and its speech bubble stay beside her instead of vanishing. Its bubble has a real tail that touches the guide, also when the guide is the small helper next to Misty, and it never sits on the Daily Quest or the crumb line under it, even while those are faded, on a phone held upright or sideways and on iPad. One tap still brings all the menus back.

The menu now stays hidden while you fly: when Misty leaves a world, floats home or stops, the menu and buttons no longer pop back by themselves a second later. Tap anywhere once to bring them back.

Small maintenance update, no new gameplay in this one. It is a fresh build so you can check that your phone picks up updates right away. Nothing in the app changed. The next updates with real changes are being built now.

Fly Misty anywhere: inside a world, touch Misty herself and drag left or right to turn her. Only she turns, the world stays put, and a few soft lights in front of her show which way she faces. Touching anywhere else still turns the world. Hold her controller still in the middle and she flies straight ahead into the world, and the camera swings in behind her. Tap twice and she backs up for a moment, then stops by herself. Tap once, then hold, and she keeps backing up. While you hold, slide the controller left or right to steer and up or down to climb or dive. Three quick taps start the autopilot (that used to be a double-tap). She can now fly much further, right out to the edges and down into the dark of each world, so you can get a little lost and find your way back. Fixed: tapping Meals (and every other sheet that slides up from the bottom) opens properly again. Since the level bubble update those sheets were opening invisible. The Meals bubble also stays in its spot while Misty flies, and the 3D bubbles no longer turn pixely when your phone gets warm or is in Low Power Mode.

Some edges give way if you push long enough.

Home is symmetric now. Four living bubbles sit around Misty: Meals and Move on top, Fasting and Water below. The new one, upper left, is Meals: it shows how many meals you've logged today, like 2/3, and fills up as you go, because every meal charges Misty. Tap it to log a meal, or long press it to see today's meals. The sun/moon button moved down to sit above Sound, the same way VR sits above World map, and it still works the same. The weather is a round bubble now, with its icon above the temperature. The Daily Quest and the Today pill are real liquid drops now, curved all the way round with no straight lines. Mist rule: inside a world, the mist and clouds around its edge are the forbidden edge. Push Misty into them and she can wander out there and get a little lost: she fades into the mist, can't quite hold a line, and drifts back once you let go. Every world has two clear gaps in the mist where the universe shows through, marked by a soft starlight glow. Only pushing outward through a clear gap for 3 seconds flies you both out. On autopilot she heads for the nearest gap by herself. Day & night menu: tap the sun/moon button three times quickly to open it, and tap anywhere else to close it. It now opens every time. One tap still switches Day and Night. There is no long press any more, and holding your finger anywhere in the app no longer selects text or pops up the copy menu.

Clean flight view: when Misty flies on autopilot, the menu bar, the top row, the bubbles, the Daily Quest and the buttons fade away, so only Misty and her world are left. When you steer her yourself, everything fades except the controller. Tap anywhere once to bring it all back: that tap does nothing else, and she keeps flying. The movement bubble now stays in its own spot while she flies, instead of sliding to where she used to sit.

Misty's ways in and out of worlds now feel like real travel. On autopilot she no longer flies straight in: she circles the world, getting smaller and smaller as she falls closer, like a ship in orbit. The first time she reaches it she skims the edge and gets flung back out, on a low-energy day maybe twice, but she always gets in by the third try. And she can leave a world for real now: steer her against the edge of the world and keep pushing outward for 3 seconds. Light gathers where she presses, and then you both fly out, the camera with her, back into the universe beside the world you left. No more snapping back into her bubble. On autopilot she does the same: she flies to a corner, presses against it for 3 seconds and flies out on her own. Everything that pops up now looks like Misty: reminders like "Your 16 h fast ends at", Misty's gift of the day (it used to say Kometa's), the little praise lines, XP banners, the update bar and the Fast done card all wear her bubble: see-through blue glass with her violet rim, a cyan edge of light and her soft glint. Everything works and sits where it did. Tips now wait for you: a tip only counts as read when you tap it (Nice, OK or its button). If it fades away on its own or you tap past it, it comes back later, and no tips pop up while Misty is flying, on autopilot or while you steer. A journey fact joins your cell's list only when you tap Into the collection. Misty's praise speaks as a cell now, no more leaves or roots. World hunt: the little cell guide next to Misty now talks to you in real speech bubbles, with a tail pointing back at it, instead of pop-ups at the top. Its bubble never sits on the Daily Quest, the crumb line under it or the controls. It says a lot more now: how many crumbs it senses, Warmer! when one is close, which way to try when you're lost, that one is hiding behind you, that crumbs only count when you steer yourself, and three new facts about every world. When Misty cheers, her line comes out of Misty herself. The crumbs are only a game and don't change anything in your real body. Levelling up is quieter now. The big XP card under the Daily Quest is a small bubble of Misty's glass: a thin ring shows how far she is to her next form, with one short line like Next: Glimmer · 70 XP to go. It only shows up when she evolves or gets another quarter of the way, and it's gone after 3 seconds. The level-up note above the menu bar is the same small bubble now, not a gold bar. Tap either one to open your path, as before. Home: VR, Sound, World map, the day/night button, the Today pill, the weather pill and the Daily Quest are now made of Misty's own living bubble, the same one as fasting and water. They shimmer, glow and breathe with her, keep their shape (Today and weather stay pills) and stay exactly where they were. Everything works the same. World hunt: inside a world you can now always see how many are left. A slim line under the Daily Quest shows the world, one dot per crumb and, for example, 2/6 collected · 4 left. When you've caught them all it says World clean, so you know you can fly on. It's a game, not a health reading. Today: a new movement bubble sits next to water and fasting, made of the same living glass. Tap it and four small bubbles bloom out: Quick, Medium, Long and Epic. Pick how your walk or bike ride felt, no minutes or steps to type. The bubble fills up, Misty does a happy dance and you see exactly what it added to her energy. Four quarters fill the day. Only time on your feet or on a bike counts, not sitting on a bus or train. Picked the wrong one? Pick again within a minute and it replaces it. Long press the bubble to see today's moves and remove one again. If you already logged a workout on Move, the bubble is already full, so nothing counts twice. The menu bar, the weather pill and the sun/moon button are now made of the same liquid glass as Misty's bubble: see-through blue glass with her violet rim and a cyan edge of light. Everything is where it was and works the same: same buttons, same weather, same day and night switch. Today: the fasting and water bubbles are now the same living bubble as Misty's, the same glassy shimmer, glow and breathing, and they react to your touch the same way: press and they squish and spring back. Everything they show, like your fasting time, goal and end time or your glasses of water, now sits inside the bubble, just like Misty sits inside hers. The separate Edit button above the fasting bubble is gone: long press the fasting bubble to change when your fast started. Tapping works as before. Misty stays Misty inside every world: when she flies into a world, on autopilot or when you steer her, you now see her there with her energy ring, and the camera follows her. The little cell creature of that world is only her small helper flying beside her. Today's status line now matches her energy ring too. Misty's world hunt: every world now hides little sugar crumbs and murky germs, tucked far away in its corners, 4 on a calm day and up to 10 after spiky meals. Steer Misty with her controller and fly her right up to one: she gobbles it up, gets power and her world clears a little. Clear them all and the world sparkles again. Each one gives power that levels Misty up, makes her a little faster and gives her energy a small boost, up to a daily limit, and each crumb only counts once a day. Flying into a world yourself powers her up too, once per world a day. On a low-energy day the pull is weak and she may bounce off the edge once or twice, so keep trying. The little explainer in each place now flies next to Misty like a sidekick. Inside a place you can pinch to fly much closer, toward the spot under your fingers, and pinch out to float back. It's a game, not a health reading. Misty's energy scale: now you can see exactly how she's doing. A thin ring on her bubble fills with her energy, the two marks on it are the next levels, and her name tag shows the percent. Hold Misty to open her card: her scale from Low to Okay to Full, how far it is to the next level, and the 1 to 3 quickest things that get her there right now, like 1 Move and 2 glasses of water, each with what it adds. It counts with the same fair rules as the world weather, so what it promises really happens, and repeats or fast taps never count. Power-ups from her world hunt show on it too. It's a game world, not a health reading. Today is clean again: there is no extra Adventure button. Misty's adventures start from her controller, just tap it three times. World weather is fast and fair now: your world turns stormy the moment a spiky meal or product is logged, and every good step clears it right away, a little for a glass of water, more for a Move or a low-spike meal. Your last few days only set a gentle starting mood. Logging the same thing twice or tapping fast adds nothing extra. It's a game world, not a health reading. Today: Misty goes on adventures. Tap her controller three times (autopilot) and she drifts slowly through her world like a fish in an aquarium, from corner to corner, sometimes wandering off and getting a little lost before she finds her way back. Gravity pulls her into a world, she shrinks and falls in, and rises out the same way. Touch the controller to steer her yourself, or tap her empty cell and she flies straight home. She brings back small finds, up to 5 a day, and only explores while you watch. Her hints now follow how your world is doing: a stormy sky, a Move calming it, a hazy inside or clear skies, always kindly and only about the game world. When her energy is too low for trips, she tells you what would fill her up again. Move: Mirror mode. Tap Mirror mode on the Move screen, pick Desk chair, Standing at the desk or Floor stretch, put your phone where the guide shows and turn on the camera. You see yourself with a glowing glass outline over you: step into it, hold still, 3-2-1, then move with it. If you leave the picture, it waits for you. Your camera picture stays on your phone, nothing is recorded or sent. No camera? Follow the same outline without it. Move: the workout figure is now a person. Instead of Misty with arms and legs, a human silhouette in the same liquid glass does every exercise with you, in time with the clock, and the muscles you are working glow. Misty stays as she is everywhere else. Faster and cooler: the app does much less work in the background now, so it should feel quicker and keep your phone cooler. The old rain and leaves no longer flash for a split second when you open it. Community: energy balls are now live for everyone. When you shoot with the energy joystick, everyone in the Community sees your ball fly from your companion at the same moment, and you see theirs. It hits the same person on every phone. Scanning is simple now: you see the product, one big answer (will it likely spike your insulin or not, an estimate) and one button, Catch it. Catching earns XP whether it spikes or not, and adds it to the spike lists everyone can browse and search, including foods that look healthy but spike. The estimate is smarter: vegetables, oats and plain dairy no longer show as spikes. Under it: cheaper at other stores, and community deals you can post with the store, price and how long the offer runs. Community: voice notes. Tap the mic next to the message box to record and the arrow to send, or hold the mic, let go to send and slide left to cancel. Tap a play button to listen, in the chat or right in the speech bubble. Photos now show a small picture in the speech bubble. Tap someone's companion to send a stream of light to them and start talking; press and hold a companion to open their person card. Scan has a new look: Snap food opens a full-screen camera with a big shutter, Photos, Type it and a Barcode switch that really jumps to the barcode camera. Your photo, Log a meal, the barcode result and the not-found card are now blue glass on black space, and if the camera is off, a glass card shows you how to turn it on or lets you choose a photo instead. Cook: every meal now has two clear buttons, Cook it and Shop it. They sit on Cook under the shuffle button, on the shuffled meal and on every recipe. Shop it opens your cart in the same blue glass: the stores sit in one row and say which is cheapest, the cart is a glass bubble, and you tick items off right in the list. Shop at … opens a big tick list for exactly those items in aisle order, and the round X no longer covers it. New for grocery shopping: scan a product and see straight away whether it's likely to spike your insulin (spike, mild or no spike, an estimate from the label). One tap on Add to cart puts it on your shopping list as in your cart, and the camera is ready for the next product. Sugar, carbs, fibre, protein and ingredients are under Details if you want them. Turn on Shopping at the top of Scan, or tap Scan a product in your shopping list. New: everyone now gets their own unique companion. During sign-up, your birthday (and your birth time, if you know it) brings a being of light to life. Its star sign gives it a colour and a mythic feature, and the day and hour shape its look, name and personality, so no two companions are alike. It is not a he or a she, it is an entity. Already have an account? Open Profile and tap your companion card to bring yours to life. Today: Misty now goes into the worlds by herself. Open any place and she follows you in a moment later and roams around freely. On autopilot she visits each place on her own, roams inside, then moves on to the next. Today: Ride along and its video screen are gone. Misty already flies your real world. Your inside stays as one short line, tap it to read it all. Body journeys now say what comes next: tap Start next journey and Misty sets off and flies around her galaxy, or see Next journey tomorrow with the time left. The journey log names the place your cell discovered instead of a cut-off sentence. The sun starts fresh every night at midnight, and when it is full it shows when the new sun comes. Fixed: Misty's energy bar stays inside its card. The Today sheet has a new look: dark space with the same blue glass as the weather pill and Daily Quest. Every row and shortcut has the same height and rounded corners, the old mint, beige and orange buttons and bars are now blue glass, the text is easier to read, and the X under it is glass too. Everything works the same. New in Move: Misty now has little glass arms and legs and does every exercise with you in the workout player, marching, curling, walking, bridging, with the working parts glowing. Community: the typing bar is now solid dark blue glass, so you can always read what you write. Speech bubbles behind it fade out while you type. Sound: the string pad on Today now really sets the background sound. The string you touch picks the key, higher is brighter and fuller, and sliding along a string shifts the pitch. You hear it change right away, it stays that way, even after you close the app, and Reset sound brings back the original sound. Fixed: every person card in Community now shows a real join date, also for older accounts. New in Community: an energy joystick in the bottom right corner. Pull it and your companion turns into a pointed energy shape, let go and an energy burst flies. Hit someone and their companion rolls off like a billiard ball, bumping the others, and they get your energy. Then everyone drifts back to their spot. Community: the people now stand out. The world behind them steps back, a little darker and softer, and every companion sits on a bright blue glass disc with a clear name. Community: the worlds start circling each other the moment you open it, no more waiting a few seconds for the background to move. Community: zoomed out, the clear tube that cut a line through the bubbles is gone. Your world now carries soft waves of light instead. iPad: your profile picture and the Day/Night button now sit right next to the weather, in one row under your greeting. New: after every update, "Show me" walks you through each new thing, one by one, like the first tour. Sound: once you turn it on, the calm sound keeps playing in Community, Cook and Move too. It only steps aside while a video, a voice note or the workout plays, then comes back. Scan: typing a barcode number works again. The box and its Go button now sit right above the keyboard, and the water button is gone from the scanner. Your XP card is now blue glass, sits right under the Daily Quest instead of over the top row, and uses Misty's comet forms. Scan: tap Scan and only your iPhone asks for the camera, once. Our own "Allow camera" card is gone. Scan now sits in the same living spirit world as Community, Cook and Move, and the camera fades in over it. If the camera is off, a small blue glass card says so, with a blue Try again button and an easy way to type the barcode number instead. The Scan tab now lights up while you scan. New in Community: the world around everyone is now a living cellular galaxy, with glass cells full of tiny cells and glowing webs, soft curving threads of light and sparkling dust. No more stray companions in the background, so the real people in Community stand out. Fixed in Cook: tapping Post in For You opens the New post window and it stays open, so you can add a link, video, photo or caption and post. For You now opens as a blue glass window inside Cook, in the same spot as Shuffle and Swipe, and you swipe up and down through the posts right there. New on Move: start a workout and it opens full screen over the living world in blue glass. Misty does each move with you, and the body parts doing the work glow. New: the sun/moon button on Today and the video Close and Open buttons in For You now wear the same blue glass as the weather pill. Fixed: double-tap the world on Today to zoom again. It switches between Misty close up and the World map, the same as a tap on the stick. On iPad the check-in reminder now shows as a blue glass card under the top of the page, not up in the status bar. Fixed: person cards in Community show the date someone joined instead of a long number. New in Community: send a photo. Tap the photo button next to the message box, pick one or take one, add a caption if you like and send. It is shrunk on your phone first and its location data is removed. Tap someone's companion to open their glass person card: their picture, star sign and personality only if they chose to share them, when they last wrote, and buttons to chat or send energy. The last old gold and purple buttons, cards and sheets around the app are now the same blue glass as Daily Quest. New: steer Misty out of her bubble. Drag the glass controller and she pushes against her bubble, stretching it like a soap film, then slips out without popping it, at the same size as in her bubble. Fly her anywhere in your world. Near a glowing place she gets smaller, and right at its edge she warps in, the same as tapping it. Inside, she is there with you and you keep steering her. Tap a place instead and you go in without her, as before. Sound is calmer: the world now plays soft pads and singing bowls, and the Move and session timers ring a gentle bowl instead of a beep. Open Sound on Home for a glowing string pad: touch or swipe to play, higher is louder, slide to bend the note. Inside Gut, Pancreas, Brain and the other places, a small glass guide now travels with you and tells you about the place in a Misty-blue bubble. Tap it for the next line. New: on Today, the fasting and water bubbles now look and move like Misty's own bubble: almost clear inside, a soft violet and cyan rim, and the same slow wobble and breathing. New: Cook, Move and Scan now live in the same living spirit world as Community. Leave Today for any of them and the camera pulls out past your bubble; come back to Today and it flies down to Misty again. Fixed: when you travel into a place in your world, its "You arrived" card now sits right under the Daily Quest box, no longer over the sun/moon button and your profile picture. It fades away as soon as you leave the place, go back to Misty, open the World map or switch tabs. New: Community is now your living world, not a picture. Pinch out on Today, or push the World map stick up, and you keep flying out past the World map, out of your own bubble, until you see everyone's glowing bubbles joined by threads of light, with the companions gathered out there. Tap Community and it is the same pull-out as a quick warp; going back flies you down to Misty. A plain tap on the stick switches between the World map and Misty. Move: the workout length buttons (5 to 60 minutes) now sit in one clean, centred glass row under Start and never cover it. Cook, For You: shared YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Vimeo videos now play right in the feed, in the platform's own player; only links that can't be embedded still open outside. New on iPad: Today has one centre line. Your greeting is at the top, the weather pill sits right under it in the blue glass, and the Daily Quest box is centred below, also with the iPad held sideways. New on Today: the top row is even. The weather pill sits on the left in the same blue glass as Daily Quest, the sun/moon and your picture on the right, your greeting in the middle, and the Daily Quest box is centred right under it, also on iPad held sideways. The weather view is the same see-through blue glass. New: when Misty levels up, you now see her real self in a blue glass card over her world, with her new stage name. New: a little glass controller sits above Today. Drag it and you fly Misty around her world yourself. Tap it three times and she goes on her own adventure that you can just watch, slow and sleepy when her energy is low. Touch it again to take over. The ring around it is her energy. Tap her empty bubble to call her home. Fixed on iPad: in Cook, Swipe now sits next to the tiles instead of below the screen. For You shows Misty's living world around the videos instead of black. The menu bar is the same blue glass as Daily Quest. Coming back from Community no longer flashes old meal and fasting steps. Community is a real map now: everyone keeps their own spot like a pin, so tapping someone selects exactly them and nobody moves. Drag to look around, pinch or double-tap to zoom. Typing keeps the map still and only lifts the message box. Bubbles step aside so they never cover anyone, and the Chat room now shows the companions' replies too. Easier to read: the small grey lines on the Today pill, the Today shortcuts and the Cook and Profile tiles, and the Community chat's small text and send arrow, are now clearly readable. Removed: the microbe buddies and the microbe collection are gone, along with the XP they gave. Misty is your only companion. Fixed: going back to Today from Move, Cook or Scan now glides like iPhone home screens: the world stays put behind both pages, no dark page, no edge, no ghost of the last page. Fixed: World map inside a place now flies you back out with the same warp, played backwards, and lands on the whole world. No more jump. New: tap Misty and she answers: hey, a giggle when you tickle her, slow down if you keep poking, and lines that follow her energy. A World speed slider sits under the day-night slider. The wardrobe is see-through. On iPad, Sound, World map, VR and Kometa's gift line up evenly. New: Community bubbles work like Snapchat's map: each companion's name and newest words sit in a small glass bubble right above them, yours above you. Photos say New picture and open when tapped. Tap Misty to pet her, hold her for her levels. Trip notes now sit inside the Daily Quest box. Fixed: Home → Community no longer flies a rectangle at you. Community looks like Misty's spirit world from far out, with round cartoon speech bubbles next to whoever is talking. New: Misty doesn't smile all the time anymore. Full of energy she looks calm and content, okay she looks neutral, low she looks sleepy or a little sad. Her energy comes from the meals, water and Moves you track. Too tired, she stays home; while she's out, her bubble shows when she's back. Tap a glowing place and you travel there right on Home, then World map flies you back. And VR is right on Home: tap VR above World map and tilt your phone to look around. New: Community is now the spirit galaxy. Zoom out from your body and see everyone's bodies floating, with speech bubbles. Tap someone to talk to them directly. New: Home is your body world now. No extra tap to get in: drag to look around, pinch with two fingers to zoom, tap World map to see the whole world and tap a glowing place to travel there. Misty sits in one simple bubble, and the sound button is right on Home. Today opens instantly: no more glimpse of the old Home when you tap back. New: tap Misty and you now see the same Misty as on Home, with her evolution path: her current form big, the XP to her next form and all six forms ahead. Tidied up: dressing up Misty is gone. The wardrobe, outfits, Misty's room with the window and plasma cushion, the shop and the old herb pieces like the Maple crown, Mist scarf and Acorn pot are out. Misty now changes only through her six forms. Your XP and level stay exactly as they are, and nothing of it ever cost you anything. Kometa's gift is now one small glowing spot bottom left in your world, once a day. New in Community: the planet. Your companions stand together on a little planet and talk in speech bubbles. Fixed: Scan. The white Back bar is gone; close the scanner with the round X top left, like every other screen. Deep analyze at the bottom is fully visible again, nothing covers it anymore. The camera now opens every time you open Scan, and starts again by itself when you come back to the app. New in setup: “I want” now lists only real goals like Fewer cravings or More energy. PCOS, insulin resistance and pre-diabetes have their own optional spot, “Anything we should look out for?”, in Profile too. Whatever you tap now lights up green. And the question now asks: When are your cravings strongest? New: Spirit square. Community → Chat is now one shared room with real people, no demo messages. Your type and star sign only show if you choose to share them. Reply, mention and react, drafts are kept, and quiet hours (10 PM to 8 AM, adjustable) keep chat alerts silent at night. Fix: on the iPad held upright, the top bar and quest card no longer sit across Misty in the middle of Home; they are back at the top and you can tap Misty again. New: Home opens into your body world, with Misty at the centre. Water and fasting stay close; tap Today for your log and goals, Misty for her companion sheet, or the zoom button for the whole world. Close sheets with the round X. New: the body world now shows how your day is going. Clear world: bright look and a light, airy sound with soft high tones. When you log spiky food today or scan in spiky products, the world turns stormy: darker, murkier colours and a low rumble joins the sound. A logged Move calms it, and a day without spikes stays clear. The line under the world title says why. It is a game mood, not a health check. New: Misty evolves with you. Her form grows over six stages from your star sign and style, with markings from form 3 and a crown at form 6. She cheers when you log or scan a low-spike meal and braces at sugar bombs (no points for reactions). The longer your fast, the calmer she glows. In her world, tap Evolution (or Wardrobe), then Your companion’s forms to see all six and pick her style. Friends see her form in their friends tree only if you turn sharing on. New: body sound. In the 3D world, tap Sound at the top to turn on light, airy sounds and warp sounds when you fly into a place. It only plays when you turn it on, with its own volume and an off switch. And the autumn leaves stay outside now: no more leaves inside your body. Fixed: the Update button. Tapping Update now loads the new version right away and says it is working. If it takes too long, you can tap Try again, and if it still hangs, close LOWiSPIKE completely and open it again. Offline it tells you to wait until you are back online. New: points only for things you really do. Taps, switching tabs and opening menus give no XP anymore. You earn XP for logging meals and water, finishing a Move session, finishing or correcting a fast, finishing a body journey, a new buddy, care for a friend and the first time you discover a body region. Healthy actions in a row still build a streak: 3 in a row +10, 5 +20, 8 +40 with a big celebration. New: you can fix when your fast started. On Home, tap Edit start on the rim of the water bubble (or in the fasting sheet next to "since"), pick the date and time of your last meal and save. Your fast keeps running; the fast's own points still come once, when you end it. New: arrival cards. When your cell arrives somewhere in your body (a place in the 3D world, the end of a cell ride or a body journey), a gold card shows the place, one real fact about it and how today's entries show up there. Close it with the X; the 3D view stays free to drag. New: Day & night. In Profile > Look & sound, slide through the whole day like a timelapse: morning mist, day, golden hour, blue mist and night stars. Everything in between is there too, and the sky, mist, stars, your cell and the 3D world move with your finger. Jump straight to Day, Night or Auto (follows the real sun). The button top right switches Day and Night with one tap. New: opening the app is clean now. You see one calm LOWiSPIKE screen for a moment, then your finished app appears in one go, no more older screens flashing by first. It also starts faster. New: flying to a place in your body world is one smooth zoom again. Tap a glowing place in the 3D world, or pick it on the World map, and you glide through the bloodstream straight toward it, faster and faster, dive into its glow and land inside. Back pulls you out the same way. The extra row of place buttons at the bottom is gone: the World map (lungs included) and tapping the world are all you need. New: microbe buddies. Lacto moves into your cell as your first buddy, and up to three microbes from your collection can join. They float around your cell, sit with you at home and orbit in the 3D world. They light up at their favourite thing (low-spike food, water, movement …), grow closer every day, and one comes along on your body trips. Tip: tap a buddy in your herb. New: your world follows the seasons, all by itself. Right now it is autumn: a warm golden glow on Home with a few leaves drifting down, an amber light around your cell and in its home, and a soft golden haze in the 3D bloodstream. It works in light and dark mode and changes with the date, no setting needed. New: ride along with your cell. On Today, tap Your inside, pick a place, and your cell travels through the vessels in the 3D world. Drag to look around while it moves, pinch to zoom, and tap Gyro to look around by tilting your phone. The more you eat low-spike and earn XP, the clearer and brighter your inside gets. Friends tree: tap a friend and send them care right from there. Your body world grew: open the 3D world on Home and tap a place. You travel through a blood vessel into seven regions of your body (brain, lungs, heart, liver, pancreas, gut, muscles) and can look around in each one by dragging, pinching or tilting your phone. Back takes you to the bloodstream. New: body journeys. On Home, tap the adventure bar and pick a ticket: your cell travels to the gut, liver, heart, brain and more, and comes back with a real fact about that place. Up to 3 trips a day, and each one lands in your adventure log. The weather on Today now opens on top even while an update note is showing. New here? You now start by planting and naming your herb, and it greets you by name. A few quick questions build your starter plan: small daily steps, each with a "Why?" and a tap straight to the right screen. You'll find it on Today, and you can redo it any time under Profile > About you. New: your cell has a home. Open your herb, then Wardrobe, and tap Home to decorate it with the pieces you own. In Community, the tree icon next to the title opens your friends tree: real friends only, by invite link or from the Community, and it only shows names, cell names and levels, never health data. Tap the weather on Today: your weather opens inside the app, with the next hours, high and low, and how today's weather affects your body and blood sugar. The black bar at the top of the profile pages is gone. New: your body world in real 3D. On Home, tap the 3D window to open it full screen. Drag to look around, pinch to zoom, and on a phone tap Use motion once, then tilt it to look around like VR. Tap a glowing place to fly there. Your herb is now a living cell. Look inside: it mirrors what you log. After a Move everything pumps, a sweet spike fills its world with sugar crystals for a few hours, water and low-spike meals keep it clear, and late at night it is awake but tired. Open it from Home and tap how you feel. A picture of your entries, not a measurement. New in your body universe: open your herb and tap the cell icon at the top. The microbe collection has 18 body buddies, from the insulin messenger to the mitochondrion, each with a real fact. You find them with meals, water, Move, scans and fasting, and repeating unlocks new colours. Under Friends you can send real friends a hug, a good night or a "drink water", and the adventure log keeps what your cell discovers on body journeys. Deep analyze, which opens your custom GPT, sits at the bottom of the scanner. Barcode, Snap food, Log meal and Water +1 all live in Scan now. Tap the herb on Home and you get just your herb: play, wardrobe, collection and its path. You can now support LOWiSPIKE on Ko-fi, right from the app: Wardrobe, Shop, Pay what you want. One-time or monthly, or simply 0 €. It's voluntary and unlocks nothing, everything stays free. New on Today: a short good-morning card once a day with your day count and one goal. Tap the Goal chip in your log to pick a rhythm, like 3 days this week or a kind streak where a missed day only pauses. In Safari, Add to Home Screen is now three illustrated steps. Tap your level: the herb path shows the next form, the rule and how much is left. Plus special quests with hints, up to 2 weekly missions, your own goals with a direct link, and your food collection. Rewards now wait for Claim. Your day has a sun now: every meal, scan, glass of water and Move fills it, and your herb cheers you on. Fill it and your herb goes out to the garden and brings you back a find. Your herb has a shop now. Open the wardrobe and tap Shop: Kometa brings one free piece every day, a new shelf three times a day, and the Mist Moon drop with three autumn pieces. Every piece shows how to earn it, XP is never spent, and nothing is for sale.
text.de:
Dein Tag, von deinem Begleiter zusammengefasst: Begleiter gedrückt halten und Dein Tag antippen, oder Mein Tag öffnen. Mahlzeiten mit wahrscheinlichem Blutzuckeranstieg, längste Pause, Move, Wasser, gesendete Fürsorge und Punkte, eine ehrliche Erkenntnis, ein Tipp für morgen und eine Zeile fürs Tagebuch. Kommt auch nach dem Speichern von Heute nachtragen.

Kommst du erst abends ans Handy? Heute nachtragen: eine große Blase nach der anderen für Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Snacks, Wasser und Bewegung. Antippen, was du hattest, dann einmal Speichern. Erste Zeile in den Einstellungen, und abends bietet es dein Begleiter an.

Beende eine Bewegen-Einheit, auch Spiegel-Modus und Kreuzheben: Du bekommst die größte Belohnung der App und ein großes Fest. Jede beendete Einheit steht jetzt in Diese Woche und Verlauf.

Im Warenkorb auf Jemand anderes zahlt tippen: Der ganze Korb landet bei Hilf mit. Ungefähre Summe und Zahlungslink rein, teilen.

Im Supermarkt auf + bei jedem Produkt tippen: ab in den Warenkorb, ohne es zu öffnen. Das Haus legt es direkt in deine Küche.

Sprechen statt tippen: Essensnamen, Suchen, Küche, Einkaufsliste, Snacks, Bildtexte und Chat haben ein kleines Mikro im Textfeld. Tipp drauf und sprich, nochmal tippen zum Stoppen. Es nutzt die kostenlose Spracherkennung deines Handys. In der Home-Bildschirm-App auf dem iPhone öffnet das Mikro die Tastatur: Tipp dort aufs Mikro der Tastatur.

Kochen öffnet jetzt in der Küche. Lieber ein anderes Spiel zuerst? Halte seinen Tab, bis er wackelt, und schieb ihn nach vorn.

Die Scanner-Karte ist klarer: Eine kleine Kurve zeigt den geschätzten Blutzuckeranstieg, Wie oft sagt, wie oft pro Woche es passt, und Warum? erklärt das Urteil in einfachen Worten. Nüsse und Käse werden jetzt für ihre übliche kleine Portion bewertet.

Ladenfunde ist einfacher: Scanne Essen beim Einkaufen, sammle XP für deinen Begleiter, Power-Kombis ganz oben.

Jeder Scan zeigt jetzt dieselbe kurze Karte: ein Urteil, eine bessere Wahl, wenn sie hilft, und der Rest unter Details.

Im Supermarkt gibt es jetzt Von zu Hause einkaufen. Sag, für wie viele Personen du einkaufst, dein Budget und wie viele Abendessen, und du bekommst eine Woche Low-Spike-Abendessen mit geschätzter Summe für jeden Laden. Tausch jedes Abendessen, hak ab, was du schon zu Hause hast, und leg den Rest mit einem Tipp in deinen Warenkorb.

Der Supermarkt in Einkaufen hat jetzt einen Warenkorb, mit Mengen zum Ändern und einer geschätzten Summe. Die Summe nutzt nur Preise, die Leute im Laden gemeldet haben. Seller Zone hat weiter ihren eigenen Tab.

Hilf mit ist jetzt ein Stapel zum Wischen: Korb nach rechts, um ihn über den eigenen Bezahllink der Person zu bezahlen, nach links zum Überspringen. Rückgängig holt ihn zurück.

Deine Küche ist jetzt ein Spiel: Öffne Kochen und tipp auf Küche, direkt neben Mischen und Swipen. Kühlschrank und Schrank zeigen, was du zu Hause hast, jede Tür öffnet ihr Fach, und ein Balken zeigt, wie gesund deine Küche ist. Etwas ist leer? Ab in den Mülleimer, dann steht es auf deiner Einkaufsliste; tipp auf Gekauft und es ist wieder im Fach.

Hilf mit hat jetzt einen eigenen Tab im Shop, direkt neben Küche.

Unter Über dich kannst du jetzt Frau, Mann, Nichtbinär oder Keine Angabe wählen. Und du kannst eine Erkrankung eintippen, die nicht in der Liste steht, zum Beispiel Sichelzellkrankheit. Diese Notiz bleibt auf deinem Handy.

Nach dem Essen in Gap kannst du dir jetzt vorlesen lassen: Tippe auf einer Phasenkarte auf den Lautsprecher, und die Tutorial-Stimme liest sie vor, mit 1×, 1,5× oder 2×. Nochmal tippen stoppt. Gap öffnet jetzt auch auf der Phase, in der du gerade bist.

Nach dem Essen in Gap: was dein Blutzucker typischerweise macht, Phase für Phase, und je ein einfacher Weg, den Spike zu senken.

Essensfoto korrigieren: Beim Tippen kommen zuerst deine Küche und deine Scans, und mit Lebensmittel hinzufügen ergänzt du, was fehlt.

Mein Zyklus, wenn du ihn nutzt: ein sanftes Wie geht es dir heute?, dazu ein sanfter Tag und eine ruhige Welt, die du selbst einschaltest. Deine Zyklus-Einstellungen sind auch zurück. Nur du siehst das.

Küche im Shop: Hier steht, was du zu Hause hast, plus ein Einkaufswagen für später. Tipp auf Gekauft, dann kommt es in deine Küche. Nur du siehst das.

Sprechtempo im Tutorial: wie bei einer Sprachnachricht auf 1× neben Pause tippen für 1,5× oder 2×. Die Stimme wird sofort schneller, klingt natürlich, und dein Tempo bleibt gespeichert.

Alle bei LOWiSPIKE in einer Liste. Öffne das Community-Menü und tipp auf Leute: Du siehst alle in der App mit Name und Foto, auch wer offline ist, und kannst nach Namen suchen. Tipp jemanden an für das Profil, schließ es, und du bist wieder in der Liste.

Scan halten öffnet alle Bubbles. Halt auf Home den Scan-Knopf kurz gedrückt, dann gehen alle Bubbles auf einmal in einem Kreis um Misty auf. Kurz tippen öffnet weiter Scan. Tipp daneben, um sie zu schließen.

Community-Karten zeigen jetzt Geburtstage mit Countdown, Sternzeichen und Persönlichkeitstypen. Vorher stand auf jeder Karte Nicht geteilt. Jede Karte zeigt den Geburtstag als Tag und Monat mit Countdown, nie das Jahr oder dein Alter, dazu dein Sternzeichen. Deine Persönlichkeit erscheint auch, falls du sie hast. Noch keinen Typ? Deine eigene Karte verlinkt den kostenlosen Persönlichkeitstest auf Deutsch, und mit Ich kenne meinen Typ speicherst du das Ergebnis.

Chat und Rangliste zeigen jetzt nur noch echte Menschen. Die Testkonten und simulierten Mitglieder sind weg.

Im Tagmodus siehst du jetzt, was du im Chat tippst. Vorher war die Schrift weiß auf dem hellen Nachrichtenfeld.

"Müsli mit Milch" wird beim Eintragen einer Mahlzeit jetzt als Müsli und Milch erkannt. Vorher zählte es nur als ein Glas Milch. Bircher-Müsli klappt auch, und ein Müsliriegel bleibt ein Riegel.

Eine auf Spanisch eingetippte Mahlzeit wird bei Mahlzeit eintragen jetzt genauso bewertet wie auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Bisher galt "Avena con leche" nur als Milch und brachte +15 XP, während "Haferflocken mit Milch" keine brachte. Jetzt versteht die App avena, arroz, pan, pollo und andere spanische Alltagswörter fürs Essen, und "sin" lässt etwas weg, wie "ohne".

Zyklus-Tracking für Frauen, nur wenn du es willst. Die Einrichtung fragt, und Mein Zyklus in deinem Profil zeigt deine Phase als kleine Zellwelt. Trag den ersten Tag deiner Periode mit einem Tipp ein.

Wer "Oats with milk" bei Mahlzeit eintragen tippte, bekam Hafermilch, ein Getränk mit 110 kcal. Haferflocken, Overnight Oats und Rolled Oats zählen jetzt als Haferbrei, und Hafermilch bleibt Hafermilch. Bei den Zutaten steht nicht mehr so etwas wie "vitamin d as ingredient". Und beim Mahlzeitenfoto erklärt die LOWiSPIKE-Zeile ihr Urteil jetzt auf Deutsch statt auf Englisch.

Nur echte Menschen im Ranking und bei Freund hinzufügen. Bots und Testkonten sind dort verschwunden, und jeder Name steht nur einmal da. Die Bots bleiben mit ihren täglichen Fotos im Chat.

Wenn du in Scan ein Essen eintippst, steht die Zeile unter Beste Alternative jetzt auch auf Deutsch da. Vorher kam sie bei Essen wie Apfel, Milch oder Haferflocken auf Englisch, zum Beispiel "A small handful of berries & a palm of protein". Jetzt heißt es "Eine kleine Handvoll Beeren & eine Handfläche Eiweiß".

Wörter in den Bubbles bleiben ganz. Die kleinen Bubbles um Misty trennen kein Wort mehr in der Mitte, wie "Flasch" in einer Zeile und "e" in der nächsten. Ein Text bricht jetzt nur noch zwischen Wörtern um, und ein Wort, das zu lang für seine Bubble ist, wird stattdessen etwas kleiner. Danke, Lisa, fürs Finden.

Neue Begleiter mischen deinen Geburtstag jetzt mit etwas, das nur dein Konto hat. So bekommen zwei Leute mit demselben Geburtstag verschiedene Begleiter. Deiner bleibt genau so, wie er ist.

Zurückwischen bei Einkaufen schließt jetzt Einkaufen, und du bleibst bei Kochen. Vorher blieb Einkaufen offen, Kochen ging dahinter zu, und beim nächsten Wischen warst du aus der App. In der Einkaufsliste im Laden schließt Zurück erst die Liste, dann Einkaufen.

What's New ist jetzt eine kurze Tour im Stil des Tutorials. Sie bringt dich direkt zu jeder Neuerung in der App und zeigt sie dir, Überspringen geht jederzeit. Sie kommt einmal pro Update. Diesmal: Räume, Kreuzheben im Spiegel-Modus, die Seller Zone, Sleep im Bubble-Ring und iPhone und iPad synchron.

LOWiSPIKE auf den Home-Bildschirm holen ist jetzt eine kleine animierte Anleitung statt viel Text. Wähl iPhone oder Android (deins ist schon ausgewählt) und sieh dir die genauen Tipps in Dauerschleife an: auf dem iPhone •••, Teilen, Mehr anzeigen, Zum Home-Bildschirm, Als Web-App öffnen an, Hinzufügen. Kommst du aus Instagram, TikTok oder WhatsApp, zeigt sie zuerst, wie du in Safari oder Chrome kommst. Auf Android-Handys, die es erlauben, öffnet ein Tipp auf App installieren direkt den System-Dialog. In Safari zeigt ein leuchtender Pfeil auf den echten •••-Knopf, und wenn du die App zum ersten Mal vom Home-Bildschirm öffnest, freut Misty sich mit dir.

Behoben: "Neu in diesem Update" kommt nicht mehr ständig wieder. Jedes Update meldet sich einmal, in einer Karte. Verstanden oder Zeig's mir schließt sie für immer, auch nach dem Neuladen und auf deinem anderen Gerät. Später lässt Update-Hinweise 3 Stunden in Ruhe.

Eine klarere Einrichtung. Der Schritt über dich heißt jetzt Über dich und sagt, warum wir fragen: damit deine Tipps zu dir passen. Der Einkaufs-Schritt sagt in einer Zeile, wofür er da ist, ohne Dinge, die du noch nicht kennst. Und wenn dein Begleiter geboren wird, bekommt er einen freundlichen Namen: Tipp auf Neuer Name für einen anderen, oder auf Selbst benennen und gib ihm jeden Namen, den du willst.

Kreuzheben im Spiegel-Modus. Öffne Move und tipp auf Kreuzheben. Stell das Handy auf Knie- bis Hüfthöhe, geh etwa 2,5 m zurück und stell dich seitlich hin. Ein leuchtender Umriss zeigt dir die Hüftbeuge mit flachem Rücken und Hüfte nach hinten, ist höchstens eine Wiederholung voraus und wartet oben auf dich. Gezählt wird deine eigene Hüftbeuge, nicht die Uhr, halbe Wiederholungen zählen nicht. Haltungs-Tipps kommen in Bubbles, jede saubere Wiederholung leuchtet türkis, und Misty feuert dich nach jedem Satz an. 3 Sätze mit 8 Wiederholungen und einer kurzen Pause, die du überspringen kannst.

Die Update-Hinweise stimmen wieder. Nach mehreren Updates von heute hat der Hinweis die Tour zu einer älteren Änderung angeboten, etwa "Bubbles gehen in einem runden Kreis auf" oder die Fotos in der Seller Zone, und die eigentliche Neuigkeit kam nie. Was du verpasst hast, steht gleich darunter, das Neueste zuerst: Räume, die du selbst starten kannst, und eine Misty auf iPhone und iPad.

Dieselbe Misty auf jedem Gerät. iPhone und iPad haben jetzt einen gemeinsamen Stand: Wasser, Fasten und die Lücke, Mahlzeiten, Move, Schlaf, XP, Level und Mistys Pflege. Wenn du die App öffnest oder zurückkommst, holt sie den Stand deines anderen Geräts und sagt es dir kurz. Hast du auf beiden Geräten etwas geloggt, bleibt beides, nichts zählt doppelt. Die Sprache bleibt pro Gerät, und Gesundheitsdaten verlassen dein Handy weiterhin nicht.

Die Seller Zone zeigt jetzt echte Produktfotos. Jeder Snack hat sein Foto aus seinem eigenen Shop, so siehst du auf einen Blick, was du kaufst. Die Karten sind jetzt ein Regal: zuerst das Foto, mit dem Urteil und dem Preis darauf, dann der Name, die Portion und wohin geliefert wird. Zwei nebeneinander auf dem iPhone, drei auf dem iPad. Warum es okay ist und die Zutaten öffnen sich mit einem Tipp. Tippst du auf das Foto, öffnet sich der Shop. Das Regal in Einkaufen und die Alternativen unter einem Scan zeigen die Fotos auch.

Beim Enthüllen deines Sternzeichens in der Einrichtung stand auf Deutsch etwa "Geboren aus die zwei Fische". Jetzt heißt es richtig "Geboren aus den zwei Fischen", bei jedem Zeichen. Außerdem blinkt der Bildschirm nicht mehr, wenn du in der Einrichtung Eine Frau, Ein Mann oder Sag ich lieber nicht wählst.

Die Seller Zone ist jetzt direkt in Einkaufen. Öffne Essen, dann Einkaufen: Oben siehst du jetzt zwei Tabs, Supermarkt und Seller Zone. Im Tab Seller Zone siehst du die ganze Zone, mit denselben Karten, Regalen und Regionen, und scrollst direkt dort durch alle Snacks. Im Tab Supermarkt steht oben jetzt ein Regal mit den Snacks der Zone, durch das du seitlich wischst. Tippst du auf einen Snack, öffnet sich die Zone direkt bei seiner Karte. Einkaufen merkt sich, welchen Tab du zuletzt offen hattest.

Die Seller Zone startet jetzt mit Shops, die dorthin liefern, wo du bist, auch wenn dein Handy auf einer anderen Sprache steht. In Deutschland siehst du zuerst Deutschland und EU. Auf UK oder USA wechseln kannst du weiter.

Jede Bubble sieht jetzt aus wie eine echte Bubble. Log meal, Cook, Shop, Sips, Cup, Bottle, Casual, Steady und Epic tragen dieselbe helle, lebendige Hülle wie Misty und die Bubbles um sie herum. Sleep öffnet sich jetzt wie die anderen: Tipp drauf, und 7 Std.+, 6–7 Std. und <6 Std. blühen auf demselben Kreis auf, die Antwort von letzter Nacht ist markiert. Halt Scan gedrückt, dann gehen alle zwölf auf einem vollen, gleichmäßigen Kreis auf.

Neu: die Seller Zone, Snacks zum Bestellen. Lust auf Chips, Schokolade, Gummis oder Kekse? Scann sie, und unter dem Urteil siehst du jetzt echte Snacks, die du stattdessen kaufen kannst, zum Beispiel Käse-Chips, Algen-Snacks, 100 % Kakao, Biltong oder gesalzene Nüsse. Jeder ist nach unseren strengen Scanner-Regeln geprüft, und jeder Link öffnet die Produktseite des Shops. Die ganze Zone öffnest du über Essen, dann Einkaufen, oder mit Alle ansehen auf der Scan-Karte. Wähl deine Region: Deutschland und EU, Großbritannien oder USA. Fruchtgummis und süße Kekse haben nirgends bestanden. Das sagt die Zone ehrlich und bietet dir etwas zum Kauen oder Knuspern an.

Community ist ruhiger. Die halb versteckte Chat-Karte, die oben am Bildschirmrand hing, ist endgültig weg, und im Community-Menü gibt es den Eintrag Antworten & Erwähnungen nicht mehr. Räume & Leute, Suchen, dein Profil, Einladen und Einstellungen sind, wo sie waren.

Dein Universum ist wieder voll. Ein früheres Aufräumen hatte mit dem alten Home auch den lebendigen Blutstrom entfernt, darum war die Welt um Misty leer. Jetzt treiben wieder rote und weiße Blutkörperchen und Blutplättchen vorbei, dazu Lichtstrahlen und die leuchtenden Körperorte im Nebel.

Affiliates: Die Verdienst-Seite erklärt den Recruit-Bonus jetzt richtig. Jeder aktive Recruit zählt wie 5 Verkäufe, und je 3 aktive Recruits bringen dich ein Level höher. Deshalb landest du mit 3 Recruits auf Level 3, obwohl 15 Verkäufe allein Level 2 wären.

Die Rangliste liest sich schneller. Weniger Worte, mehr Symbole: Sonnenstrahlen, XP, Medaillen und Pfeile für gewonnene oder verlorene Plätze. Das Podest fährt hoch, die Plätze sortieren sich ein, wenn du Woche, Monat und Gesamt wechselst, und dein eigener Platz leuchtet. Die Regeln stecken hinter dem kleinen i. Tipp auf einen Begleiter für das Duell: ein Balken, eine Zeile, was es braucht, und eure Zahlen nebeneinander.

Dein Universum bleibt ganz, wenn sich die Bubbles öffnen. Vorher hat ein Tipp auf Fuel, Water oder Move oder alle auf einmal die Welt in einen flachen Kasten geschrumpft. Jetzt zieht sich die Kamera einfach zurück, und die ganze lebendige Welt bleibt um dich herum, von Rand zu Rand.

In der Rangliste stand bei Dein Platz ein alter Name für deinen Begleiter, etwa "Sunny Leaf", und den haben auch andere gesehen. Jetzt steht dort derselbe Name wie auf Mistys Karte.
